activity_description_1734780636184782116: Puffin Man: Midland Vibration!  Vinyl only reggae selector.  I love sharing the joy of reggae music with positive people and getting the hip shakers moving! I have been going to EP as a punter since the beginning, so it means a lot to be able to give back entertaining people with the music I love!
activity_description_1734780643298321700: DJ Defensive is a reggae selector based in Sligo and Drogheda, Ireland. He has played all the major summer festivals such as Electric Picnic, Body and Soul, Vantastival, Sunflower Belfast, Dessert Island Disco, Global Grooves and The Great Outdoors. Along the way he has shared stages with such reggae legends as Jerry Dammers, Wrongtom, Count Skylarkin and Worries Outernational. He once had Don Letts ask him about a tune he was playing! Defensive has been a resident DJ in Mc Phails, Fusion night club, Odd Mollies, Mc Hughs and The Living Room. He also hosted his Rebel Reggae Frequency Show on The Isolation Station. A Defensive set encompasses the full range of Jamaican riddims including ska, rocksteady reggae, early dancehall and lovers rock. Nuff niceness!
activity_description_1734780650948732196: Sibh C is a female DJ playing ska, rock steady and Caribbean beats. Expect feet stomping head booping beats to take you away to the sunshine. Owner of street 66 Bar Dublin. Selector for over 20 years with Port Royal, Treasure Beach, Trenchtown, Body and Soul, All Together Now. Supporting Nancy Bam, Will Softly, Cian Finn and other legends.
activity_description_1734780658372650276: ZAZAMAN is an Artist, songwriter and DJ from Ramacca, a small town in Sicily. He started his musical journey in 2003, writing lyrics in the Sicilian dialect. Two years later, he became involved in the hip hop and reggae scene. In 2012, he co-founded the Ramajca Boyz, a trio made up of childhood friends from the same town. In 2015, he also started creating and editing the band's music videos. The group released their first album, Radici ("Roots"), in 2016, followed by Brexit in 2018, receiving great support from the Italian reggae scene. Ramajca Boyz have opened shows for international artists such as Shaggy, Elephant Man and T.O.K., and have shared the stage the biggest names in the Italian reggae scene, including Boomdabash. In 2025, Zazaman started his journey as a DJ. Today, he brings together reggae, dancehall and modern sounds in energetic sets, sharing his passion for Jamaican music.
activity_description_1734780670141867300: One World Sound has been operating as a reggae/world music collective for over 16 years. Gathering together a group of dedicated roots rock reggae inspired music for all ages.
activity_description_1734780670737458468: A collective of female reggae DJ's. Three little birds are sure to get you dancing your cares away. "This is my message to you -ou-ou"
activity_description_1734780680015258916: Rocksteady Social Club is a collective of DJs bringing deep cuts, heavy grooves, and unstoppable energy to every dancefloor. From soul and reggae roots and everything in between, Rocksteady Social Club isn’t just a party — it’s a movement.
activity_description_1734780680451466532: BOB MARLEY REGGAE TRIBUTE (DJ SET). One love. One heart. One unforgettable night. Join us for a feel-good reggae session celebrating the music of Bob Marley — all your favourite classics played loud, from No Woman No Cry to Three Little Birds, Exodus, One Love and more. DJ set spinning Marley all night. Singalong moments — don’t hold back! Good vibes only | Positive energy. Come sing. Come dance. Feel Irie.
activity_description_1734780693890016548: Mojo: Born in Kenya and shaped by a life of travel, Andrew Stanley is a singer-songwriter whose music blends folk, blues and acoustic rock. With soulful melodies, thoughtful lyrics and a warm, engaging style, he creates songs for wanderers, dreamers and seekers alike. Matthew Smawfield: Musician/Producer founder of The Electric Caravan which promotes original music and acoustic performances by artists like @gurugang_og and @lavosti. The band streams tracks across major platforms and frequently posts clips of their live sets and music releases online.
activity_description_1734780694779208996: Being blessed with a name that was inspired by music and spiritual power, Ceola Haile, rose through the reggae scene from birth! Spending her youth singing on Revelation Sound System, breaking bread with world class Dub artists and sound system family at the kitchen table, to sharing quality moments and music with many; such as the mighty Jah Shaka, Dan Imperial, Alpha and Omega, Conscious Sounds, Lavosti, Channel One, YT, Kebra Ethiopia, Cian Finn, Wiggle, Firehouse, Rootical, WBC, Zion Train, Murrayman, Iration Steppas and many, many more! As a young woman, she is already well versed in the roots, reggae and dancehall genre, being exposed to such veterans!
activity_description_1734780700819006756: **Chloë Pixie** is a professional contortionist and belly dancer with years of live performance experience, known for blending fluid belly dance technique with striking contortion work. Her performances are vibrant and dynamic, featuring colourful props, expressive movement, and a strong connection to music that brings each set to life. At Electric Picnic, Chloë Pixie will bring high-energy, visually captivating performances to Treasure Beach, performing to reggae-inspired sets alongside DJ Will Softly. Her style is playful, immersive, and designed to lift the atmosphere and draw audiences into the rhythm. With a strong festival presence and a focus on audience engagement, Chloë Pixie delivers a bold, feel-good performance experience that is colourful, unique, and not to be missed.
activity_description_1734780709668988196: Pearl the water nymph will be found at Treasure Beach at Electric Picnic, alongside Chloe Pixie and DJ Will Softly. Pearl is a belly dancer, and she loves to integrate belly dancing into all styles of music. She is passionate about getting the crowd moving and will be coming to Treasure Beach bringing her mysterious and sensual touch, to captivate and inspire others to move their bodies to the beat, to let go and live in the magic of the moment.
activity_description_1734780718577689892: Ian Hart: Founder of Basement Project, Scrobarnach & Lá Tech Music Conference. Ian, Galway based now, Ian is heavily involved in the electronic music scene in the west of Ireland. A DJ and vinyl enthusiast for over 14 years under his TripdiscO moniker, Ian has gained himself a reputation for his diverse taste in music, from deep, progressive house, acid, Detroit techno, and minimal, to afrobeat, reggae and worlds beats. His chameleonic and acute selections have won him residencies at a number of Galway's best music venues including The Blue Note, Factory, Club Aras Na Gael, and Electric, as well as gigs in the UK, Spain, Australia, and at festivals such as Life Festival, SunflowerFest, Decompression, Fuinneamh Festival, Vantastival, Electric Picnic.
activity_name_1735505199801611564: INKLINGS with JIMMY O CONNELL, MARY EAGAN CAMBELL, JEANETTE EVERSON, CLARE O REILLY
activity_description_1735505199801611564: Inklings is a vibrant, welcoming creative-writing group based in Mullingar, Co. Westmeath. Formed in 2016, it brings together writers of all abilities, styles and genres who share a passion for the written word. For this reading they're joined by members Jimmy O'Connell, Mary Egan Campbell, Jeanette Everson and Clare O'Reilly — poets whose work ranges from Dublin storytelling to finding elevated meaning in the everyday.
activity_name_1735505209163298092: LUAN PRESS with LEE SHERIDAN, ANDY PORTER, ELENA STACK MARTIN, MICHELLE BOSONNETT
activity_description_1735505209163298092: Founded in 2022 by Lee Sheridan, Luain Press is an Irish publishing platform championing prose, poetry and spoken word from new and emerging writers. This showcase gathers Luain Press voices Lee Sheridan, Andy Porter, Elena Stack Martin and Michelle Bosonnett — from award-winning debut collections to work spanning Ireland and beyond.
activity_name_1735505215488308524: CASS NORTH, KEVIN BRENNAN, COLM McGEARAILT
activity_description_1735505215488308524: A three-hander of distinctive voices. Cass North is a poet from Ireland's north coast, winner of the 2024 Speak the Word Poetry Slam and the 2021 Bangor Poetry Competition, with work featured internationally. Kevin Brennan is a Dublin actor, novelist and poet, seen on stage in the acclaimed civil-war drama The Best Man. They're joined by Colm McGearailt.
activity_name_1735505223289713964: SLIP OF THE TONGUE with WAYNE POWER, NICOLA SPENDLOVE, TIM O DRISCOLL
activity_description_1735505223289713964: Slip of the Tongue, launched in 2022, is a night of spoken word, poetry, live music and comedy hosted by Waterford artist Wayne Power — a supportive but cutting-edge platform for up-and-coming talent. Here Power is joined by Nicola Spendlove, a writer, actor and producer who moved from spoken word into theatre, and Cork poet Tim O'Driscoll, an Honours English graduate and Munster slam finalist.
activity_description_1735505231351166252: Two contrasting acts share the stage. Sean Corrigan returns to Electric Picnic — a writer focused on rhythm and tongue-twisting wordplay, exploring self-expression through poetry and fashion. annie & the witness are a Dublin-based post-punk band who debuted in 2024, drawing on art rock, spoken word and gothic aesthetics to channel intimate rage and spectacle.
activity_name_1735505239764940076: THE MAGIC OF MYTHOLOGY WITH MARTY MULLIGAN, BOBBO THE BARD
activity_description_1735505239764940076: A spellbinding celebration of story and song hosted by Marty Mulligan — a Mullingar native, a major driving force in the Irish festival scene and a passionate champion of his hometown. Joined by Bobbo the Bard, The Magic of Mythology blends words, myth and music.
activity_description_1735505247029474604: d_abdu is the moniker and the Xbox 360 gamertag of Ethio/Irish musician Dara Abdurahman. Hidden in plain view playing bass in BRICKNASTY since its inception, Dara now pursues his own sound, drawing from Elliott Smith, Grouper and The Microphones to make up the DNA of the d_abdu project.
activity_description_1735505255208367404: Blending the grit of the blues, laid back folk and the heart of classic soul, Nathan Johnston is part crooner, part storyteller crafting songs that sit somewhere between retro and modern but with a timeless appeal. Hailing from Mullingar in Ireland, Johnston first made waves under the alias Sion Hill touring Europe with acts like Pete Doherty, A ha, and Alice Merton.
activity_description_1735505263924131116: With a sound that fuses vibes from Dolly Parton, and Simon and Garfunkel, Heron Red is a dynamic folk duo with a full-band sound. The band blends traditional Irish music with Americana, country, and traditional folk. Composed of songwriters Molly Buchan and Callum Wall, the duo crafts music that ranges from stripped-back storytelling, echoing the poetic depth of Bob Dylan and Joni Mitchell, to the soaring, full-bodied energy of The Waterboys and Planxty.
activity_description_1735505269804545324: Sei Green is a Dublin-based project led by duo Adam Garrett and Ellen Sleator. Blending soul, funk and disco with dreamy psychedelic textures, they create groove-led songs that feel hazy, immersive and quietly emotional. Their sound sits somewhere between laid-back funk and dream pop, with smooth basslines and lush layered instrumentation carried by breathy unison vocals. The warmth of their recordings is brought to life on stage by Will Aranha on drums and Arthur Noswitz on guitar, adding movement, texture and depth to their hypnotic rhythms. Drawing subtle comparisons to Khruangbin, Men I Trust and Parcels, Sei Green crafts music that feels both intimate and expansive, reflective lyricism wrapped in melodies that linger. At its heart, Sei Green is two pals making groovy, sleepy music, soundtracks for slow mornings, late evenings and everything in between.
activity_description_1735505278738412844: Baleia Baleia Baleia formed in late 2015. The band consists of Manuel Molarinho (bass and vocals) and Ricardo Cabral (drums and vocals). They are highly regarded in the independent Portuguese music scene for blending urgent, vibrant punk energy with witty, socially conscious lyrics that turn misery into a party.
activity_description_1735505285776454956: Adore are a dynamic Irish garage-punk trio formed in 2022. Known for their melodic, guitar-driven sound, the group has quickly become a standout act in the Irish underground scene. Adore's frantic, kinetic style combines garage punk ferocity with elements of surf and early Britpop. They are often likened to legendary bands like The Breeders, Elastica, and their Irish contemporaries, Sprints. Known for a commanding gang mentality on stage, they have relentlessly toured across Ireland and the UK, supporting bands like Sprints, The Scratch and Chalk, as well as performing at festivals like All Together Now.
activity_name_1735505292730610988: CARLA BEATTIE, RUDE JUDES, ADELE LEAHY, DANIEL BRESLIN
activity_description_1735505292730610988: Four spoken-word voices with plenty to say. Carla Beattie is a mother, psychologist and poet writing about parenthood, womanhood, love and identity. Rude Judes serves witty observations of life drawn from Australia, London and Cobh. Adele Leahy is a seasoned performer and slam finalist who's graced Electric Picnic and the Fingal Poetry Festival. They're joined by Daniel Breslin.
activity_name_1735505299433108780: FIONA O LOUGHLIN, CAT BROGAN, DOM BYRNE
activity_description_1735505299433108780: A rich mix of performance poetry. Fiona O'Loughlin is an actress and multidisciplinary artist from Co. Clare whose lyrical, character-driven work is steeped in Irish music and folklore. Cat Brogan, from Omagh, is the 2024 Ulster Poetry Slam Champion, exploring place, memory, queerness and post-conflict identity. Dom Byrne is a Kilkenny poet, Dublin-based, bringing his own wry, warm style.
activity_name_1735505306613757228: THE POETRY KILN COLLECTIVE with ANNIE PETER, ANNA D, MIKEY CULLEN, DAVID HYNES
activity_description_1735505306613757228: The Poetry Kiln Collective is a Dublin-based platform for contemporary spoken word and interdisciplinary performance, hosting open mics and workshops. This year they've toured with Mike Garry, shared a stage with David J of Bauhaus, and performed at Seamus Heaney HomePlace. Featuring Annie Peter, Anna D, Mikey Cullen and co-founder David Hynes.
activity_description_1735505314389996844: Three dynamic voices from the Irish scene. Roisín Kearney, aka FloRo, is a spoken-word artist, poet and rapper from Dublin 22 and a fixture of the booming Irish hip-hop and poetry scene. Julie Goo is a bilingual poet, writer and singer from Cork City, an award-winning slam poet published in Poetry Ireland Review and The Stinging Fly. They're joined by Latrice.
activity_name_1735505323558745388: LAUREN McNAMARA, BEN McCAOILTE, HAZEL HOGAN
activity_description_1735505323558745388: A powerhouse trio. Dr Lauren McNamara is a Limerick poet, playwright and essayist, three-time Munster slam champion and author of Quarter Life Crisis. Ben MacCaoilte is a multidisciplinary artist blending poetry, spoken word and experimental soundscapes rooted in Irish storytelling and folklore. Hazel Hogan is a Dublin poet and facilitator whose poem 'Grangegorman' features on the Junior Cycle syllabus.
activity_description_1735505332610053420: The Dead Thatchers (Alienpig Rave Experiment) are an offshoot of the Glasgow art-punk collective, pairing Derry-based Glaswegian spoken-word performer and musician Willy Copeland's beat- and loop-driven electronic soundscapes with live words. Joined by Annie Francis, a bilingual poet whose fiery, anti-capitalist work spans the Irish language, Palestine and our connection to nature.
activity_name_1735505343901119788: THE ADVENTURERS WITH JOHNNY COYNE & FRIENDS
activity_description_1735505343901119788: Johnny Coyne is an Irish adventurer, entrepreneur and speaker from Clonbur, Co. Galway. Alongside paddling partner Liam Cotter he completed a monumental expedition, and now brings The Adventurers to the stage — a rousing set of storytelling and friends celebrating the spirit of adventure.
activity_description_1735505352264561964: Good Strangers are an Irish indie band whose music offers a lyrically bare-chested exploration of transition — love, loss, sexuality and the shift from free-spirited youth to adulthood. Best friends since childhood, led by singers Niamh and Co, they bring warmth and raw honesty to the stage.
activity_description_1735505360300848428: Alternative Donegal singer-songwriter George Houston was raised on classic folk, pop and rock from his parents' vast collection of CDs and vinyl. Always encouraged to play freely, he developed a natural feel for melody and instruments from an early age.
activity_description_1735505368127419692: DAGDA is a new music and artistic collective founded by poet Leon Dunne and Simon Jones, former bassist of The Verve and guitarist for Gorillaz. The collective is currently slow-releasing their debut album 'MONGRAL', which features multiple Irish and UK based artists including former band members of The Verve: Simon Jones and Peter Salisbury, with new tracks scheduled for monthly release throughout the year. Blending Irish traditional music with rock, folk, blues, and jazz alongside spoken word and poetry, DAGDA stands apart through its seamless integration of multiple artistic mediums. Music and poetry are not merely combined but balanced as equal forces, creating a rich, sonic experience that transcends conventional boundaries.
activity_description_1735505377036121388: Beat Club, a Mullingar-based improvised music collective, take to the stage on Saturday. Rooted in improvisation, Beat Club moves fluidly across jazz, funk, blues, soul and beyond, with no two shows ever the same.
activity_description_1735505384778806572: Paulie Martin is a renowned musician, singer and songwriter whose work brings stories of love, excitement and culture through rhythmic, poetic lyrics, dynamic vocal harmony and acoustic rock-band arrangements.
activity_name_1735505393595233580: ANNE TANNAM, ALICIA BYRNE KEANE, CATRIONA LANE
activity_description_1735505393595233580: Three award-winning poets. Anne Tannam is the author of four collections, most recently 'dismantle' (Salmon Poetry, 2024), and a former Poet in Residence with Poetry Ireland. Alicia Byrne Keane is a Dublin poet moving between spoken word and the page, writing on housing, nature, gender and everyday life. Caitríona Lane is a bilingual writer from Dublin, now in Connemara, and a multiple Irish-language poetry award winner.
activity_description_1735505399836357932: Tiny Little Gods is the creative partnership of Sarah and Aaron Lennon Ross, who over twenty years have worked across textile design, theatre, film, illustration and stand-up, now bringing their blend of dark humour and craft to the stage. Joined by Keith Hanna, performing extracts from his debut spoken-word play with music.
activity_name_1735505409986573612: EVA MARY LUCY, HOLLY HUGHES, CHIAMAKA ENYI-AMADI
activity_description_1735505409986573612: Three of the finest voices in spoken word. Eva Mary Lucy is a Belgian artist based in Dublin, winner of the 2024 Talkatives Grand Slam and 2025 All-Ireland Poetry Slam Championship, representing Ireland at the European championship. Holly Hughes, from Clonakilty, took her sold-out show to Dublin and Brighton Fringe and represented Ireland at the 2025 Poetry Slam World Cup. Chiamaka Enyi-Amadi is a commissioned poet and anthology editor published in The Stinging Fly and Poetry International.
activity_name_1735505418366793004: A-MUSING with JOE SKYLARK, LIAM McCABE, CORMACK Mac GEARAILT, DAVID HYNES
activity_description_1735505418366793004: A-Musing returns to Electric Picnic with its trademark mix of hilarity and depth. This year's team brings together Liam McCabe, Joe Skylark, Cormac Mac Gearailt and David Hynes, with special guest Alan Nolan — musicians and spoken-word artists weaving music and poetry into one warm, funny, moving set.
activity_name_1735505424792466732: RISING TIDE with LEON DUNNE, SHEILA RYDER, KALLE RYAN, JOHN CUMMINS
activity_description_1735505424792466732: Rising Tide showcases the phenomenal breadth of poetry and music talent across Ireland, giving artists a platform to reach a wider audience. This session features Leon Dunne, a working-class Dublin poet writing with high energy about voices outside the mainstream; All-Ireland slam finalist Sheila Ryder; spoken-word trailblazer and LINGO co-founder Kalle Ryan; and John Cummins.
activity_name_1735505434355479852: DUBLINS FINEST with JAMES WILLIAM DILLON, NICOLA CLARE, CONOR KILEEN
activity_description_1735505434355479852: Poetry is having a moment in Ireland, and Dublin's Finest is at the heart of it — built by artists for artists, showcasing up-and-coming poets and musicians from the basement of Sin E to the Electric Picnic stage. Featuring James William Dillon (aka Jimbo), Fingal Slam winner; Nicola Clare, a north-county Dub who says yes to every stage; and Conor Kileen, whose sold-out debut 'Yup The Poems x' lit up Dublin this year.
activity_description_1735505446720288044: Dec (Declan) Byrne is a staple of the midlands live-music scene, known for his distinctive voice and acoustic guitar, performing original songs alongside popular classics.
activity_description_1735505455016621356: Steph Hurley is an Irish singer/songwriter taking the music scene by storm across Ireland and New York City. Now based in NYC, Steph can be found performing at some of the city's busiest and most vibrant music venues, delivering unforgettable shows packed with energy, emotion, and personality. With her infectious stage presence and ability to connect with audiences, Steph is quickly becoming one of the exciting new voices emerging from the Irish music scene. Her single 'I'm Fine.' was named Track of the Weekend by RTÉ 2FM, further cementing Steph's place as a rising artist to watch. Steph is thrilled to return to Electric Picnic for a second consecutive year.
activity_description_1735505462306321708: Some One's Sons are one of Ireland's most exciting emerging folk acts, blending traditions of Irish folk music with contemporary songwriting and raw storytelling. The five-piece from Mullingar have earned a reputation as one of Ireland's most dynamic live folk acts, delivering powerful performances and original songs that capture the realities, struggles, humour, and spirit of modern Irish life. Drawing inspiration from The Clancy Brothers, Planxty and Christy Moore, the Sons have developed a catalogue of original songs that blend heartfelt storytelling with the energy and spirit of modern Irish folk music. In 2026, they released their debut EP The Boom Is Back. They recently embarked on their debut Irish and UK tour, which included sold-out shows in London, Liverpool and Dublin, and have shared stages with Sharon Shannon, Seán Keane, The Wolfe Tones, George Murphy, The Fureys and The Scratch.
activity_description_1735505475149280556: George Murphy is an Irish singer-songwriter from Beaumont, Dublin, who exploded onto the scene with memorable appearances on RTÉ's You're a Star, quickly winning over audiences while still just out of school.
activity_description_1735505482464146732: DELYRA is an Irish folk group rooted in tradition yet unafraid to explore its darker, more evocative edges. Formed in the heart of the Irish Midlands, the band brings together musicians whose individual stories and talents intertwine to create a sound that is both timeless and strikingly original.
activity_description_1735505493042181420: Ruaile Buaile are an Irish based 5-piece twisted-trad band, based in the midlands of Ireland. The group formed in 2011. In 2021, world renowned musician Cathal Guinan (fiddle) joined the band, followed by Seán Bourke (banjo) in 2023. Along with original members Niall Kelly (vocals and guitar), Jack Godley (percussion) and Shane Lynam (vocals and bass), the quintet are entertaining audiences with a bigger than ever sound. From upbeat old Irish favourites, ground thumping trad, and unique twists on recent day classics, this collective are bringing their energy to masses around Ireland and further afield.
activity_name_1735554547625462656: Laois Today and Colm Parkinson of the Smaller Fish Podcast
activity_description_1735554547625462656: Local media favourites LaoisToday return to the festival with a sit-down interview featuring one of the biggest names in Irish sports broadcasting — Colm Parkinson of the Smaller Fish Podcast. He'll chat about his own football career, his move into the media, and how he built the biggest GAA audience in the country.
activity_name_1735554550385314688: Crime World Podcast with Nicola Tallant: The Dapper Don
activity_description_1735554550385314688: Crime World is a hit podcast hosted by award-winning Irish investigative journalist Nicola Tallant, exploring the gritty realities of organised crime, drug cartels, and the global underworld.
activity_description_1735554559889607552: Ireland's number-one bilingual podcast, live and unscripted. Doireann Ní Ghlacáin, Louise Cantillon and Síomha Ní Ruairc slide between Gaeilge and English mid-sentence, covering everything from group-chat drama to the state of the nation. No grammar drills, no modh coinníollach, just craic den scoth.
activity_name_1735554567942671232: RTÉ Documentary On One: The Composers — Úlfur Eldjárn, Paddy Flynn & Alma Kelliher
activity_description_1735554567942671232: Experience the soundtracks that drive hit true-crime and investigative podcasts. Every RTÉ Documentary On One series features a custom-commissioned soundtrack that acts as the musical heartbeat of the story. All are then released as standalone soundtrack albums. In this exclusive session, three award-winning composers dissect the art of music composition for audio storytelling. Alma Kelliher reveals how she channelled tension for the recent dark investigative series, Pirate Predator. Icelandic Music Award-winner Úlfur Eldjárn breaks down his haunting, award-winning score for Where is Jón?, the story of a missing Icelandic poker player. And local Laois-based composer Paddy Flynn shares his melodic approach to tracking the global con artist Samantha Azzopardi in the series Finding Samantha. They'll share their inspirations, break down their creative processes, and each will perform live tracks from their scores. The ultimate collision of original music and gripping audio journalism.
activity_name_1735554569955937152: The Irish Times Inside Politics Podcast with Political Editor Pat Leahy and Political Correspondents Ellen Coyne and Jack Horgan Jones
activity_description_1735554569955937152: The paper of record's politics podcast, live in a field. Political Editor Pat Leahy is joined by political correspondents Ellen Coyne and Jack Horgan-Jones to unpack the summer's plotting and what the autumn holds for the Coalition. The Dáil may be in recess, but the intrigue never takes a holiday.
activity_name_1735554572589960064: House Warming with James Kavanagh and William Murray and Kim Buckley
activity_description_1735554572589960064: Housewarming is your inside look at real Irish homes transforming for a greener energy future. The show is all about helping you to make your home a warmer, more energy efficient, and beautiful place to live. For this special live episode, host Kim Buckley is joined by James Kavanagh and his partner William Murray. James and William have left Dublin, which they've called home together for the last 11 years, in search of a simpler life in the countryside. They've bought a house in Kilkenny with an acre of mature garden ready for planting and growing, and have undergone a major renovation to make their home more energy efficient and suitable for their lifestyle. They join Kim to chat about their renovation journey and hopes and plans for the future.
activity_name_1735554574561282944: Catch Up with Louise McSharry and Carl Kinsella with Emer McLysaght
activity_description_1735554574561282944: The weekly podcast that takes the news and the nonsense equally seriously, recorded live at MindField. Louise McSharry is joined by her regular news correspondent Carl Kinsella and special guest Emer McLysaght, co-author of the Aisling novels, to sift through the week just gone: politics, culture, reality television and whatever the group chat is currently fighting about.
activity_name_1735554576658434944: Paul Howard presents: Ross O'Carroll Kelly
activity_description_1735554576658434944: Nearly three decades, twenty-odd novels and one weekly Irish Times column later, Ross remains south Dublin's most quotable rugby jock. Creator Paul Howard brings him to life on stage: Sorcha, Honor, the old man, and whatever fresh disgrace the Rossmeister has visited on the southside this season. A field in Laois is not remotely Ross's scene, which makes this all the sweeter.
activity_name_1735554580508806016: Shane McCarthy - I Said What I Said
activity_description_1735554580508806016: One of Ireland's most-followed content creators takes the chat off the phone and onto a stage. Shane McCarthy's weekly podcast has built a devoted audience on pure honesty: life, love, pop culture and the stories most people would keep to themselves. Unfiltered, chaotic and very funny. He said what he said.
activity_name_1735554582505294720: Fifth Court Podcast with Jason Carty on The Beatles
activity_description_1735554582505294720: Ireland's legal podcast meets the most litigated band in history. Barristers Peter Leonard and Mark Tottenham are joined by Beatles obsessive Jason Carty of Nothing Is Real to open the case files: the break-up suit, the wars over Apple, and how four lads from Liverpool kept half the lawyers in London busy for decades.
activity_description_1735554589149072256: Irish history with the reverence removed. The hit comedy history podcast takes the national story — rebels, chancers, saints and absolute disasters — and tells it the way it would be told at the back of the bus. Educational despite itself.
activity_name_1735554600532413312: Behind the Scenes: The Art of Investigative Audio with RTÉ Documentary on One. Shauna McGreevy, David Doran, Nicoline Greer, Liam O'Brien
activity_description_1735554600532413312: Step inside the multi-award-winning world of RTÉ Documentary on One to discover how gripping investigative journalism becomes world-class audio storytelling. The creators behind hit narrative series — including The Nobody Zone, Finding Samantha, Runaway Joe, The Real Carrie Jade, Where is Jón?, Stolen Sister and Pirate Predator — reveal their deep-dive reporting craft. This session explores everything from spotting stories and chasing tip-offs to navigating tricky legal waters: how they build trust with vulnerable sources, verify facts under pressure, and handle listener feedback, all while maintaining strict ethics. The team will also focus on First Conviction, a recent co-production with RTÉ Investigates about a couple wrongfully imprisoned for a crime that never happened, and who were recently declared factually innocent by the Irish courts.
activity_name_1735554602570845056: The Pleasure Agenda: Grace Alice Ó Sé and Annie Queeries
activity_description_1735554602570845056: Sex, intimacy and everything Ireland spent a century not talking about. Award-winning sex educator and Sex Educated author Grace Alice Ó Sé is joined by Annie Queeries for a frank, funny and entirely shame-free hour. Bring your questions, or just bring your scarlet face. Both are welcome.
activity_name_1735554604483447680: An Irishman Abroad with Jarlath Regan
activity_description_1735554604483447680: The comedian and pod father Jarlath Regan sits down with Irish athletics legend Ciara Mageean for a wide ranging discussion about love, life, loss and the persistence of craic in the face of adversity.
activity_description_1735554610850401152: Two London-based Irish comedians tackle the pressing issues facing parents, from the unique vantage point of having no children, no interest in children, and no intention of mentioning children at all. Mike Rice — Kilkenny-born, tens of millions of views online, and the man behind specials An Irish Disgrace and Nasty Character — and Vittorio Angelone, the Northern Irish stand-up whose tours sell out faster than he can announce them, bring their chart-topping weekly podcast to MindField. Unfiltered, unrepentant, and about anything but parenting.
activity_description_1739196788986342988: The nation's comedy sweetheart and national treasure, Deirdre O'Kane is known for her sharp observational humour and versatile performances in film, television and theatre. Her humour often explored themes of both Irish culture, family life, and personal anecdotes, earning her a loyal fan base and critical praise.
activity_description_1739196804522045004: Dubbed Ireland’s “Houdini”, Steve Spade is one of the country’s most in-demand magicians, illusionists and escape artists. Internationally recognised for blending world class slight of hand, jaw-dropping escapes and sharp comedy into unforgettable live performances.
activity_description_1739196815108468300: Diona Doherty, a regular panellist on the BBC's Blame Game. This comedian, actor, podcaster, has just landed a lead role in a 10-part CBC Canada and BBC comedy co-production, alongside Schitt's Creek actor Dustin Milligan. Sharp, sexy and sassy, she is a must-see for those who enjoy comedy with a heart.
activity_description_1739196833194307148: With a storytelling style that is as sharp as it is chaotic, Cavan man Darren is proving that the quietest parts of the country produce the loudest laughs, as seen on RTE, Virgin Media, and LadBible.
activity_description_1739196834117054028: Award-winning comedian and writer, who has had two sellout shows at Dublin Fringe Festival. Described as a new comedy arrival who could move from cult to household name in a flash. Catch her before she gets lost to stardom.
activity_description_1739196847295557196: Known for his sharp wit and dry humour, Martin has gained recognition for his performances across Ireland, the UK, Europe and the USA. His performances are characterised by intelligent one-liners coupled with tension and energy that mark him as a standout comedian on the Irish scene.
activity_description_1739196859794583116: Taran O'Sullivan is an Irish media personality and comedian known for her work on RTÉ 2FM, where she appears on the popular Laura Fox Show. Her dry, sardonic wit and storytelling cover a wide range of topics with humour and insight.
activity_description_1739196871211478604: Known for his dark wit, fearless punchlines, and ability to say the wrong thing in exactly the right way, Ian's comedy lives in that sweet spot where audiences are unsure whether to laugh, gasp, or quietly reassess their morals.
activity_description_1739196878467624524: Fred has been delivering a unique brand of comedy through his musical prowess and wild, crafted physical storytelling since 2011. Currently appearing as the affable MC on the Tommy Tiernan Show, Fred brings a special brand of comedic chaos to every show.
activity_description_1739196886923341388: Ailish has spent the last number of years earning her stripes on Ireland's stand-up scene and gaining online acclaim through her viral comedy sketches on TikTok.
activity_description_1739196897392324172: His warm, energetic onstage presence makes for an unforgettable experience for the audience. With gags that always hit the spot, his engaging, high-intensity performances make him one of the top names of must-see comedians.
activity_description_1739196904598138444: Hilariously surreal, he is scorchingly funny and charmingly engaging. This adopted Aussie comic is one of the hottest tickets in comedy clubs and festivals, both here and in the UK.
activity_description_1739196917625646668: Mario Rosenstock is a multi-award-winning comedian and one of Ireland's leading satirists and mimics, the creator and voice behind "Gift Grub" on the Ian Dempsey Breakfast Show on Today FM since 1999. He has broken all box office records in Ireland, including five sold-out nights at the Bord Gáis Theatre, eleven straight nights in Dublin's Olympia Theatre, and in 2025 became the first Irish comedian to sell out the 3Arena.
activity_description_1739196925343166028: This Italian Irish comedian, who grew up in Belfast, has risen through the ranks of comedy world at an incredible speed, building up a following with stand-up clips, podcasts and sketches, amassing millions of views online. He is co-host of the hit podcast "Mike and Victoria's Guide to Parenting” and can be seen a lot on the internet unless your, unless your algorithm hasn't blessed you thusly.
activity_description_1739196944435637836: Emer Maguire is a Northern Irish comedian known for her sharp storytelling, musical comedy genius, and gloriously chaotic honesty. Recently named by Channel 4 as one of the top 10 new comedy talents, she has been commissioned by the station as the creator and star of the upcoming sitcom "Socially Awkward" about her life as an autistic adult.
activity_description_1739196953696661068: The creator of the "Giz a laugh" online sketch series, this lovable Clondalkin native reflects on growing up in the 90's in a council estate to eventually flying first class to Australia. She explains the funny side of modern fitness culture and the many hurdles she has come up against that have shaped her into one of Ireland's top comedians.
activity_description_1739196954082537036: Bernard Casey is a comedian, actor and drama teacher from Portmagee village in County Kerry. He has sold-out shows at the INEC, Vicar Street and the Everyman Theatre in Cork. His online comedy videos have over 15 million views and have garnered him over 130,000 social media followers. "The future may be a mystery, but for Bernard Casey, it's sure to be a bright one" - The Irish Independent
activity_description_1739196959988117068: Kevin has been a staple of Irish comedy for years, hosting RTÉ's "Republic of Telly" for ten seasons, hosting "Traitors Ireland", "Uncloaked", playing the character Sim Card in "The Hardy Bucks", as well as hosting the glittery IFTA Awards. He co-hosts the "Lovely Show" podcast with fellow bogger Justine Stafford.
activity_description_1739196974156475980: Belfast comedian Paddy McDonnell has built a strong reputation across the UK and Ireland, turning everyday observations into hilarious anecdotes. He talks about getting older, dealing with gout, and the perils of still trying to be a young man and raising kids.
activity_description_1739196981697834572: Willie White has exploded in popularity over the last eighteen months, quickly marking himself out as one of the biggest names in the Irish comedy circuit, and selling over 8,000 tickets to date. He has also taken to podcasting seeing his show "You Must Be Jokin", which he co-hosts with Dublin comedian Eric Lawlor, fly to the top of the Irish podcast charts.
activity_description_1739196989297913420: Thomas Greene is an Australian comedian renowned for his high-energy comedy. His crowd work is revered, his likability off the chart, and he has the innate ability to get any audience on side with his charismatic Aussie best mate persona. Raw, unfiltered, and hysterical, he is a definite must-see over the weekend.
activity_description_1739197005638921804: A stand-up comedian, broadcaster, and best-selling author, a familiar voice on Irish radio, he co-hosted "Breakfast Republic" on RTÉ 2fm. While on television, Bernard co-wrote and starred in RTÉ's hit series "Bridget and Eamon". He also writes a popular weekly column for the Irish Examiner. His comedy often explores themes of life, relationships, and societal issues, resonating with audiences across Ireland and beyond.
activity_description_1739197016074350156: Sadhbh McLoughlin is a Dublin-based actor, writer and comedy content creator who blends sharp observational comedy with personal stories. With an Irish passport and a Brussels upbringing, Sadhbh can finally pronounce her name... sort of…
activity_description_1739197032994172492: Breda Hegarty is an emerging star of Irish comedy and has been picking up lots of awards along the way. Having grown up in rural West Cork, she remains slightly feral, but in her stand-up, Breda shows her hysterical failings as a human, which will in no doubt leave you feeling a bit better about your own life.
activity_description_1739197046382390860: Anna Clifford is a natural entertainer with a strong stage presence and jokes to match. She has had audiences across the globe laughing with her unbelievable stories and clever observations on millennial life. She effortlessly blends humour, fashion, food, and life stories with a playful, relatable touch.
activity_description_1739197060257148492: David McSavage is an Irish comedian, satirist and creator of the cult RTÉ series, "The Savage Eye". He's been making people laugh and occasionally calling their solicitors for over two decades. When he's not on stage, he's recording podcasts, or upsetting someone on X (formally Twitter).
activity_description_1739197067991445068: Patrick McDonnell, probably best known both in Ireland and abroad as the gormless Eoin McLove in "Father Ted". But don't let that fool you, with a master's degree in Irish history and a sharp and acerbic view on rural and urban life, Patrick is a surefire hit.
activity_description_1739197081153171020: Dame Stuffy isn't just a performer, she's a full-blown glitter cyclone with lashes longer than your rent receipt and a voice that could shatter both glass and egos. Equal parts outrageous and unhinged, this self-declared queen of Ballymun will leave you gasping for air.
activity_description_1739197089231400524: Currently supporting Jim Owen on his UK tour, this North Down comedian is the real deal. With beautifully timed jokes and hilariously sharp delivery, be sure to get down early to get to the comedy arena to catch him live.
activity_description_1739197096277831244: Karl Spain has long been established as one of Ireland's most popular comedians, for his own tours and touring with others. Widely regarded as the best MC in Ireland, be prepared for some killer audience work and witty badinage.
activity_description_1739197106822311500: Like many comedians, Shane is an overnight success, 15 years in the making. Hailing from Hollywood, Belfast, he is known for his top-notch observational and anecdotal humour. He has rose from YouTube sketches to sellout world tours, holding a 24-night solo record at Belfast Grand Opera House. He hosts the hit podcast "Tea with me". This modern-day king of comedy is well on his way to world domination.
activity_description_1739197116016225868: Reggie Watts is an internationally renowned musician, comedian, writer, actor, who most recently starred as the band leader on CBS's "The Late Show" with James Corden. Using his formidable voice, looping pedals, and vast imagination, Watts bends and blurs the lines between music and comedy, wowing audiences.
activity_description_1739197130318802508: A phenomenal wordsmith and world-class raconteur, there is a cruelty to Kilkenny's Mike Rice. Currently living in London, he has brought four separate solo shows to the Edinburgh Fringe and is co-creator of the hugely successful podcast called "Mike and Vittorio's Guide to Parenting", which is regularly ranked on the Irish and UK podcast charts.
activity_description_1739197141567925836: Rachel Galvo returns to EP after her debut performance last year. Blending raunchy humour with sharp social commentary, she explores her Catholic upbringing, awkward sexual encounters, and the life choices that have shaped her journey. It's a celebration of radical self-love and the joy of embracing imperfections.
activity_description_1739197156088606284: David Nihill, living in Dublin, where he was born and raised until the age of 22. David Nihill got drunk on travel and never quite got the sobriety of it. He has lived and worked in twelve countries and visited over eighty. A festival favourite, David's videos have gone viral many times over, with over one billion views and social media following of over 2 million people.
activity_description_1739197163915177548: A talented comedian, actor and content creator, Michael Fry has gained recognition for his sharp satirical stories and musical parodies of viral videos on Twitter and Instagram. His impressive credits include roles in "Derry Girls", "Holding", and "No Worries If Not".
activity_description_1739197182219120204: Aoife Dunne is one of the fastest rising new faces of Irish comedy and is also a poet and storyteller with a growing online audience of 160,000 across Instagram and TikTok. Her work blends humour and heart, often exploring themes of grief and resilience with honesty and wit.
activity_description_1739197193258528332: Apart from being one of the most in-demand comics on the land, John has written and starred in IFTA award-winning shows "The Savage Eye" and "Irish Pictorial Weekly" for RTÉ. Autumn 2026 promises more success for him when he tours his brand-new solo show, "Mighty Quack", nationwide.
activity_description_1739197202720878156: Owen Colgan is a full-time professional comedian who embarked on his remarkable journey in 2005 as the lovable character Buzz McDonald in the cult TV show "Hardy Bucks". With a passion for laughter and a love of nature, Owen brings you on a wild and crazy comedic ride.
activity_description_1739197221091929676: Simon Hennessey is a comedian, writer, actor and content creator from Dublin. His viral characters, parody songs and sketches have seen him build a following of over 430,000 on social media. He plays the lead role in the Screen Ireland film "The Kevin Intervention", which had its premiere at this year's Galway Film Fleadh.
activity_description_1739197234312375884: Katie Boyle is an Irish comedian living in New York City. Her favourite stand-up topics are her journey through American culture, dating therapy, and shame. She currently hosts "The Shift" podcast in which she and guests discuss sex and dating from an Irish perspective.
activity_description_1739197243967663692: Alison Spittle is an award-winning screenwriter, actress and touring comedian. Her latest show, "Big", won the Comedian's Choice Award for the best show at the 2025 Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Her nuanced, cheeky and joyful style, coupled with her quick wit and delivery, mark her out as a kind of genius.
activity_description_1739197262623927884: Comedian and radio presenter on Cork's Red FM, Sinéad deals with the hard topics with sharp storytelling, big heart, and a mischievous twinkle in her eye. Her most recent show, "The Cultured Culchie", was a hilarious reckoning with heart, heartbreak, identity and a long, bumpy road to finding yourself.
activity_description_1739197276498685516: Originally from Mayo, Staunton draws on stories, insights, anecdotes and characters from this unique part of the world and opens them to a global audience. He has honed a style of material which endears him to all races, backgrounds, ages and demographics.
activity_description_1739197290625101388: A charming and energetic performer, Keith is regarded as one of Ireland's comedy gems. As featured on Virgin Media TV and FM104, his stand-up blends clever observation with mischievous storytelling.
activity_description_1739197302696308300: Paul Marsh has been one of the busiest comedians on the Irish comedy scene for over twelve years. Known for his fast-paced, gag-filled sets, he has won multiple awards, including Ireland's funniest joke.
activity_description_1739197311881834060: Michael Roche is a Cork-based comedian from Kerry who began stand-up in 2019. His cheeky, playful delivery makes him instantly likable once he hits the stage. He has won several comedy competitions, including Show Me the Funny in 2026.
activity_description_1739221590769723872: Banna ceol traidisiúnta ó Music Generation Laois le páistí agus daoine óga ó Chontae Laoise.
activity_description_1739221592086735328: Ceol na nglórtha i stíleanna éagsúla. Bígí linn is sinn ag canadh cheol bearbóra, amhráin na hÉireann, snagcheol, agus cúpla iontaisín eile le linn an gcoirm ceol.
activity_description_1739221593756068320: Is ceoltóir Éireannach / Meicsiceach í Saibhin, lonnaithe i mBáile Átha Cliath. Cuireann sí draíocht ar a cuid lucht féachana lena cuid séiseanna agus liricí.
activity_description_1739221604518652384: Cairdeas, ceol agus cumhacht na mban! Beidh ceol, amhránaíochta agus damhsa ag 'Beannaithe idir Mhná' ar an árdán.
activity_description_1739221605785332192: Racbhanna cúigear leaids a d'fhreastal ar Choláiste Eoin, Baile Átha Cliath, atá sa ghrúpa ceoil Tonnta. Tá an-tionchar théis a bheith ag Oasis, Fontaines DC, agus The Beatles ar an mbanna seo, a mbaineann meascán d'amhráin cháiliúla agus amhráin fhéinchumtha lena gceol féin. Bíonn na baill seo ag seinm ceoil le fuinneamh agus óna gcroí amach - Ní chuirfear bac orthu lá ar bith feasta! Buailigí isteach chucu anseo ag Puball na G!
activity_description_1739221614694033888: Is banna rac-cheoil agus blues iad WHITEWATER as Gaoth Dobhair, Co. Dhún na nGall. Faigheann siad inspioráid ó mhórainmneacha an rac-cheoil chlasaicigh agus an blues, agus cuireann siad seó fuinniúil ar stáitse le hamhráin ó ealaíontóirí ar nós Rory Gallagher, Thin Lizzy, Cream, Jimi Hendrix agus go leor eile.
activity_description_1739221620599613920: Is amhránaí agus scríbhneoir amhrán í Hannah Mc Fadden as Dún na nGall. Téann sí díreach go croí na fírinne lena cuid ceoil, ag tarraingt as amhráin amh, chumhachtacha faoin ghrá a cailleadh, faoin uaigneas, agus faoin dóigh a dtiteann rudaí as a chéile. Tá dynamic láidir, stoirmiúil ina glór ar leith a chorraíonn an t-éisteoir ar an chéad éisteacht, rud a fhágann nach bhfuil anseo ach ceol macánta, gan scáth gan cheilt, agus tallann nádúrtha nach bhfuil ag iarraidh leithscéal ar bith a ghabháil.
activity_description_1739221628484905440: Is grúpa ceoltóirí traidisiúnta ó Thuaisceart Bhaile Átha Cliath iad Sult. Bí ag súil le ceol bríomhar, amhránaíocht agus damhsa traidisiúnta ó Emer, Caoilfhionn agus Sorcha Ní Scolaí.
activity_description_1739221635439061472: Is banna ceoil dúchais agus traidisiúnta Éireannach iad Clann Mhic Ruairí. Grúpa teaghlaigh atá iontu, agus iad comhdhéanta de na siblíní Tony (amhránaí), Aodh (amhránaí, giotár), Seán (amhránaí) agus Dónall (amhránaí, cnaguirlisí), mar aon le hiníon Tony, Megan (pianó agus amhránaí). Mar theaghlach, tógadh iad ar amhráin agus ar scéalta i nGaeilge Ghaeltacht Rann na Feirste i gContae Dhún na nGall, ceantar Gaeltachta atá suite in iarthuaisceart na hÉireann. Nuair a chloiseann tú a gceol, faigheann tú léargas ar an gcultúr saibhir seo, cultúr a leanann siad orthu á chaomhnú.
activity_description_1739221641487247840: Cuirfear tús inspioráideach leis an lá le cainteanna spreagúla ó dhaoine ar ceannródaithe iad ina n-earnálacha féin. Bígí linn agus muid ag labhairt le:
activity_description_1739221647359273440: Nuachtán úrnua a fhreastalaíonn ar phobal ilchineálach na Gaeilge. Beidh scríbhneoirí agus aíonna Scéal i mbun díospóireachta ag an bPicnic Leictreach i mbliana. Bígí linn agus ná dearmad, tarraingíonn scéal scéal eile!
activity_description_1739221654237932000: Podchraoladh faoinár mbéaloideas, ár miotaiseolaíocht, ár bpisreoga agus ár ndúchas. Buail isteach ag teach an dúchais d'oíche scéalaíochta cois teallaigh i dteannta Chían Mhic Choisteala ⁊ Chúáin de Búrca. Sa tsraith éadrom spraíúil seo, foghlaimeoimid faoi na creidimh agus na scéalta atá i gcroílár ár bhféiniúlachta mar Ghaeil. Fill ar do dhúchas!
activity_description_1739221660495833568: Cloistear filíocht ó bhéal, rap, ceol agus scéalaíocht ag an oíche filíochta ilteangach REIC. Bunaíodh REIC in 2015 le hardán a thabhairt do thraidisiún ársa na filíochta béil mar atá sí sa lá atá inniu ann agus le baile a chruthú do thaispeántais de gach cineál i nGaeilge.
activity_description_1739221666762123744: Seó grinn as Gaeilge. Cuireann siad oíche ghrinn ar siúl go rialta i mBaile Átha Cliath agus ar fud na hÉireann freisin. Cuirfidh an dream seo ag gáire gan stad sibh ón bpointe boise. Bíonn an-chraic, spleodar, spraoi is diabhlaíocht ar siúl ag na rógairí seo ar an stáiste i gcónaí, agus beidh go deimhin arís anseo ag an bPicnic Leictreach 2026 - Bígí linn!
