What began with a single VE-20 Roland vocoder has evolved into a full, hardware-driven live setup that Emma masterfully bends into her unique artform: a fully improvised performance, co-created in real time with her audience. No Emma Lohan set is complete without the unpredictable appearances of Techno God: a mythical, chaotic entity whose earthly mission is to revive car park raves and spread the gospel of Scooter. Moving between absurdity, vulnerability and hilarity; Emma Lohan is a must see in 2026.
activity_description_1755792133958453232: Gather around the fire as the much-loved Fireside Jam returns to Serenity Gardens, hosted this year by travelling musician and songwriter Dom. After 11 years busking across England and Ireland, Dom brings songs honed on the street and aimed at the stars: great chord changes, irresistible choruses, soulful lyrics, easy-flowing grooves and a rock and roll heartbeat. There may also be fabulous jackets, excellent trousers and songs so bright you’ll need sunglasses when they shine into your heart. The Fireside Jam is a warm, informal and unplugged space where musicians, singers, poets and curious festival souls can share a song, join in or simply settle back and listen. Expect songs of the road, songs for the heart, spontaneous collaborations and a little late-night magic. Bring your voice, your instrument or just yourself, and let Dom guide the gathering into a joyful glow around the fire.
activity_description_1755792141013272560: Catalan pianist Anna Xaubet Piferrer and ukulele player Jordi Sanchez Campanario come together in a blossoming of two musical worlds. Classically trained at ESMUC and Cork School of Music, Anna graduated with First Class Honours and received the Cork Orchestral Society’s Emerging Artist Award. Her curiosity draws her beyond classical music into folk, Irish music and new textures. Jordi explores the ukulele’s expressive possibilities across contemporary genres, performing with The Underscore Orkestra and The Last Petal. His solo project, Keo Kelele, released the EP Keep Moving On in 2024, the year after he received the Golden Ukulele Award at Galway Ukulele Festival. Together, they intertwine the ukulele’s eclectic voice with the piano’s classical sonorities. Their selected pieces come from vastly different traditions but wander beyond their origins through experimentation, creating unexpected pathways, fresh colours and a musical conversation shaped by curiosity, contrast and a shared spirit of discovery.
activity_name_1755792154225330160: CREATIVE WRITING ROUND THE FIRE WITH LULU SINOTT POETRY BY THE BARROW
activity_description_1755792154225330160: Lulu Sinnott is an Irish poet and spoken-word performer whose writing explores place, memory, relationships and the beautifully complicated business of being human. Her poetry has appeared in A New Ulster, Cork Literary Review, Drawn to the Light, The Prose Poem and the PrimeCut/Axis Ballymun Anthology. A warm and engaging presence on stage, Lulu has performed in Ireland and internationally, including appearances in San Francisco, New York and Berlin. She hosts the monthly Poetry by the Barrow open mic in Graiguenamanagh and co-hosts Poetry by the Sea with ArtNetDLR. Returning to Serenity Gardens, Lulu brings poetry that is reflective, intimate and grounded in everyday life—inviting audiences to pause, listen and find something of themselves between the lines.
activity_description_1755792154762201072: Let Dingle based singer songwriter Merlot Bird serenade your ears with a mix of old timey 5 string clawhammer banjo folk and bluesy guitar. Heavily influenced by her time spent in New Orleans and hitch hiking the world, you can expect melodies about life on the road, day dreamer’s ballads and other tales of celebrated wildness.
activity_description_1755792164492986352: Described as the “Irish Kate Bush”, Ciara Lawless is a Roscommon singer-songwriter known for poetic storytelling, captivating vocals and uplifting songs shaped by resilience and transformation. Ciara songs explore themes of healing, self-discovery and the power of human connection. Her music has received support from RTÉ Radio 1, 2FM, Newstalk, Hot Press and radio stations across Ireland. Ciara has toured throughout Ireland and Europe, bringing her distinctive voice, heartfelt lyrics and unmistakable flower-crown style to audiences in the UK, France, Germany and Portugal. After 2 albums Ciara has taken a leap into the dance genre blending an upbeat catchy melody with an upbeat message with another upcoming album. Her 2026 singles include No Plan B and Blessing in Disguise which have been played on BBC Introducing with Taylor Johnson & RTE 2FM’s The New Music Show With Beta DeSilva.
activity_description_1755792175339456496: At 22 years old, Cork singer-songwriter James Keegan has spent the last two years on the road, playing shows across America, Europe and Ireland while steadily building a reputation as a compelling live performer. After joining metal legend Geoff Tate on a 15-country European tour, Keegan moved on to tour America, playing six shows a week for new audiences across 43 states. Opening each night armed with only an acoustic guitar and his voice before a nine-piece metal band, Keegan carved out his own space with raw, captivating performances that consistently won over new crowds. Playing iconic venues previously graced by legends including Elvis Presley, David Bowie and Johnny Cash, Keegan continues to build his audience the old-fashioned way: through live performance and consistent touring. Most recently, James opened for Imelda May at Cork’s Live at the Marquee, marking another milestone in the journey of this exciting young artist.
activity_description_1755792184231380976: The Lady Fi Experience is a vibrant new musical venture led by vocalist and improviser Lady Fi. Blending jazz, blues, soul, world & folk, the project draws on Fi’s wide-ranging musical background. Having spent 15 years living and performing in the United States, she returned to Ireland and in the past years has been a member of The Underscore Orkestra, Rasa Nua Trio and the experimental Ás Veces Collective, as well as appearing regularly at the Cork Jazz Festival. Fi also presents Sounds Original, a radio show celebrating original music and the artists behind it. Alongside her performance work, she facilitates singing and voice-based wellbeing experiences, exploring the voice as a powerful tool for expression, connection and healing. For this performance, Fi will be accompanied by Dara O’Brien, Tim O’Leary and Jordi Sanchez Campanario. Expect jazzy arrangements, bluesy grooves, soulful moments and Lady Fi’s distinctive vocal style.
activity_description_1755792191412029424: Mark Hayes is a versatile guitarist, bassist and music teacher with an MA in Musical Performance from MTU Cork School of Music. Moving comfortably between folk, pop, blues and musical theatre, Mark brings strong musicianship, sensitivity and adaptability to every performance. He plays acoustic and electric guitar and bass, and has worked with Lady Fi and a range of local artists across Cork’s live music scene. His performance experience includes Cork Youth Orchestra, the Cork Opera House pantomime band, Culture Night appearances and musical theatre productions including All Shook Up, 9 to 5 and Fiddler on the Roof. Alongside performing, Mark shares his experience through his work as a music teacher. Whether accompanying a vocalist or taking centre stage, his playing is thoughtful, expressive and grounded in a genuine love of live music.
activity_description_1755792198190024688: Brian Leach performs on the hammered dulcimer, a cosmic instrument through which he explores traditional Irish music and journeys far beyond it. Electronics and extended techniques transform his performances into immersive worlds of melody, rhythm and improvisation. Brian tours with folk singer Lisa O’Neill and has appeared on NPR’s Tiny Desk Concert and The Tommy Tiernan Show. He also performs with MacBóchra, presenting ancient Irish myths and legends in new ways, and hosts a programme on Éist Radio. His studies in Music Technology, Musical Instrument Building and Astrophysics bring depth and resonance to his work. A member of the Irish Composers’ Collective, Brian has created immersive soundscapes for galleries throughout Ireland and released his solo album Dulcimer Dreams in 2025. Described as one of Ireland’s most prominent hammered dulcimer players, he invites audiences into a spellbinding meeting place between ancient tradition, sonic experimentation and the limitless reaches of imagination.
activity_description_1755792212475824112: Lurking in the spacetime between contemporary folk and revered tradition, you will find the music of Irish duo Geis. The band brings together Skerries singer-songwriter Paul Kelly and Mayo-born multi-instrumentalist and multiple All-Ireland Champion Ronan Donnellan, two likely lads whose paths crossed in the vibrant venues of Dublin’s traditional music scene. Kelly’s narrative songs are built on open-tuned fingerstyle and flat-picking guitar, his bardic voice augmented by Donnellan’s virtuosic touch on octave mandolin, lending hypnotic energy, overtones and colour to the mix. Geis exist at the crossroads of folk storytelling and free rhythmic expression, where words and music weave tales of love, lore and landscape with assured, formidable power. In a sound-world where ideas are minted in old Irish coinage, these two performer-alchemists transform the base metals of history, emotion, philosophy and place into narratives of glistening gold: music rooted in tradition, alive with imagination and forged for the present.
activity_description_1755792219480311792: Shimmer Boy, a guitarist first, is the artist project of Aaron O’Sullivan. Built on years of live experience, he has performed extensively across Ireland and abroad, playing everything from intimate venues to festival stages. Shimmer Boy lyrically sheds light on topics often overlooked, offering a personal perspective on matters of the heart, alongside a reflective view that leans toward the brighter side of the story. It’s honest, introspective writing rooted in lived experience Live, Shimmer Boy has supported a number of rising Irish artists including Robert Grace, Dave Lofts, and Oscar Blue, continuing to build a reputation as a compelling live act with a strong connection to audiences. The project has also received radio support, with Hideaway featuring on RTE 2FMs track of the week & continues to grow through consistent touring and releases.
activity_description_1755792227986360304: Erin & The Lens will take you on a soulful and empowering musical adventure. Drawing influence from indie, contemporary folk, jazz, trip-hop, rock and soul, the project has toured throughout Ireland and travelled to London, Edinburgh and Paris in 2025. Founder and creative force Erin Luna Gallagher draws on the Irish poetic tradition, exploring mental health, inner resilience, human behaviour, love and the mystical through her writing. Known for her versatile, entrancing voice and powerful stage presence, Erin creates both solo and collaborative performances. Her debut single, “Yellow Door”, was named Single of the Week on national radio, while its stop-motion animated music video won Best Music Video at Cork Picture House and received nominations at the Madrid Indie Film Festival 2025 and Prague Film Festival 2026. This year, Erin is joined by musicians Billy Mansfield and Brian Collins for a performance on the Serenity Gardens stage at Electric Picnic.
activity_description_1755817184800003444: Síoga Tine are a female duo from the Royal County of Meath, beneath the ancient gaze of the Hill of Tara. Celebrating the spirit of Ireland through song, chant and poetry, their work is deeply rooted in Celtic tradition and cultural heritage. Ancient melodies, spoken word and soulful harmonies are woven together to honour the stories, landscapes and sacred heart of Éire. Their performances create an evocative space where old traditions meet living voices, inviting audiences to listen, connect and journey into the magic, memory and enduring spirit of Ireland.
activity_description_1755817185219433844: Shimmy, Shake and Celebrate is a playful fusion bellydance workshop filled with movement, music and plenty of hip-shaking fun. Led by multimedia artist and dancer Kateo, the session invites participants of all levels to explore fluid technique, musicality and improvisation in a relaxed, welcoming space. A teacher with Suadela Bellydance in Cork, Kateo brings a fresh, contemporary approach shaped by training with renowned artists including Rachel Brice, Heather Stants and Alexis Southall. A recent graduate of the Tribal Fusion Education Program in the UK, she blends dance and visual art to create a distinctive, expressive style. Expect shimmies, flowing movements, creative play and a chance to connect with your body through rhythm and celebration. No previous bellydance experience is needed: bring your curiosity, your enthusiasm, to loosen those hips and get ready to move. Laugh and celebrate yourself through dance.
activity_description_1755817193817757044: GaelTronica le hArd Éan is the Gaelic Trad-inspired electronic dance project of multi-genre DJ Ard Éan. This specially curated set weaves traditional songs and dance tunes with beats, breaks, drops, synths and contemporary electronic production. Expect progressive Trad remixes, songs in Irish and Scots Gaelic, and sounds spanning house, drum and bass, trance, breakbeat, tribal and melodic techno. The set celebrates contemporary artists from Ireland and Scotland, including Jiggy, Huartan, Caoimhín, Cushla, Valtos, Niteworks, Martyn Bennett and Dolphin Boy, alongside music from Spain, America, Iceland and the Faroe Islands. Based in Connemara, Ard Éan is musician and broadcaster Paul Phelan, presenter of Coast to Coast on Connemara FM for 15 years. Born from his first public DJ performance at Éalú le Grá in 2022, GaelTronica launched at Féile Vegan 2026 and has since moved dancefloors at Uisneach, Féile Solas, Battle for the Lake and Cleggan Fringe.
activity_name_1755817206518109556: REVIVE YOUR VIBE WITH VITÓRIA SOUZA
activity_description_1755817206518109556: Wake up to another festival day with a gentle unfolding led by the Brazilian Yoga teacher Vitória. Based now in Cork Ireland, Vitória  invites you to come experience the love & joy of movement which she makes accessible to all levels. So come Revive your vibe & flow into the rest of your festival with ease.
activity_name_1755817214831220084: DARA O'BRIEN - MORNING RAGAS ON SITAR
activity_description_1755817214831220084: Enjoy the serenity of Indian morning ragas with Dara O’Brien on sitar, enriched by live electronics, psychedelic sound layers and original compositions. Dara weaves the ancient, meditative and evocative music of North India with contemporary sounds, moving through darkness and light. With a PhD in Indian music, Dara works as a music educator, music therapist, performer and composer. He has also composed extensively for contemporary dance to critical acclaim. Described by Patrick Brennan in the Irish Examiner as an “extraordinary musician and composer” and an “amazing Irish instrumentalist”.
activity_name_1755817224150963572: THE LIVING STAGE LIVE IMPROVISED THEATRE EXPERIENCE WITH YVONNE COUGHLAN
activity_description_1755817224150963572: Experience the creative heart of Electric Picnic at Serenity Gardens with director and Creative Producer Yvonne Coughlan. With over 20 years’ experience across theatre, improvisation, dance, music, film and community arts, Yvonne creates joyful, inclusive experiences that bring people together through play and connection. Join Yvonne on Saturday for lively 35-minute theatre workshop loops designed for all ages and experience levels. Drop in for a creative reset or stay longer and enjoy multiple sessions. Perfect for solo festivalgoers, friends and families, the workshops combine improvisation, acting, movement, ensemble games, storytelling and spontaneous performance in a welcoming environment. Expect laughter, connection, self-expression and a chance to step away from the crowds and discover the spirit of Serenity Gardens, one of Electric Picnic’s most loved spaces for wellness, creativity and community. Yvonne returns on Sunday as MC of the Serenity Gardens Stage, introducing a line-up of musical artists. Come curious. Leave inspired.
activity_name_1755817230828295540: REWILDING WITH THE MINDSET EXPLORER & DJ CHACHØU
activity_description_1755817230828295540: REWILDING, guided by The Mindset Explorer, is an immersive breathwork experience designed to regulate your nervous system and reconnect with your body. Using Silent Disco Headsets, emotionally loaded electronic music by DJ CHACHØU, and evidence-informed nervous system practices, you’ll be guided through a deeply immersive experience. We spend much of our lives avoiding discomfort and anything that feels unpleasant. While this is a natural protective response, it can also keep us stuck in patterns of fear, anxiety and persistent unexplained symptoms. The paradox is that lasting change begins when we change how we respond to discomfort rather than trying to escape it. PRIMAL Breathwork is one of the most natural and powerful ways to release tension and decompress the nervous system. Combined with The Mindset Explorer’s trauma-informed practices, you’ll be gently guided towards greater resilience, emotional freedom and a deeper sense of calm.
activity_description_1755817239527282036: Irish singer-songwriter Miranda Faul is quickly establishing herself as a compelling new voice in indie folk and alt-pop. Named a One to Watch for 2026 by Whelan’s in Dublin, her emotionally rich songwriting blends folk roots with soulful melodies and modern pop textures. Her music has earned support from BBC Introducing, Nialler9, Hot Press, RTÉ 2FM and Today FM. After releasing her debut EP, “Rise & Run”, in January 2025, Miranda took her music on the road with shows in Amsterdam, London, Dublin, Belfast and across Ireland. Off to a busy start in 2026, she showcased at Whelan’s Ones to Watch in January and at Ruby Sessions in March, and opened for artists including Kate Stephenson, Tide Lines, Jesse Sykes and Dear Willow in Dublin. Her sophomore EP, “The Bar Is in Hell”, is set for release early next year. In the meantime, she’ll showcase at Ireland Music Week 2026.
activity_description_1755817250969343348: CHACHØU is a French DJ, producer and co-founder of Mindset, Into the Void collectives & Rewilding experiences, based in Cork. Known for taking listeners on emotional musical journeys, she blends melodic and progressive house with tribal percussion, organic elements and downtempo to create immersive sets that inspire connection, expression and dance. For Serenity Gardens at Electric Picnic, CHACHØU showcases the more organic side of her sound, weaving together warm percussion, earthy textures, ethereal vocals and uplifting grooves that invite people to dance barefoot, reconnect with themselves and those around them, and fully embrace the moment. Fresh from performances at Éalú Le Grá, Rewild, Féile Solas, Wild & Well and Fuinneamh Festival, CHACHØU continues to create experiences where music, nature and community come together. Expect an uplifting journey filled with melody, tribal influences and grooves that celebrate freedom, connection and the joy of moving together.
activity_description_1755817260842734964: Discover the transformative power of Kirtan, a simple yet profound way to meditate through melody, rhythm and vibration. Kirtan is about letting go of fear and allowing every unique voice to merge into one soothing, collective sound. It is an ancient practice of communal chanting that can uplift the mind, open the heart and cultivate deep inner peace. This is the perfect space to completely let go and allow the music to carry you. Lea leads Kirtan straight from the heart, driven by her deep love for the practice. She profoundly believes that chanting mantras and working with sound are vital tools on our healing journey. Lea is also a certified Sound Practitioner and Vocal Alchemist.
activity_description_1755817270716126580: The Neurographics workshop is a 90-minute journey into your subconscious, where you will learn a neuroscience-informed, therapeutic art method designed to promote neuroplasticity, ease, flow and a deeper understanding of human nature. Following a simple algorithm, you will transform a negative thought pattern into a clearer, more positive insight through a guided, meditative drawing process. You will leave with your own Neurographics drawing, allowing the process to continue beyond the festival, as well as a new skill to add to your wellbeing toolbox. The session is facilitated by Yana, a certified Neurographics Specialist. All materials are provided and no previous experience is required. You don’t even need to be “good at drawing
activity_description_1755817289355613556: A playful invitation to step out of the ordinary for a while. To move, listen, laugh, dance a little and remember what it feels like to be completely at home in your body. We’ll weave together flowing yoga, playful balances, intuitive movement and music, letting the rhythm carry us between the familiar and the unexpected. A practice with enough structure to ground us, and enough freedom to let something a little more instinctive emerge. Inspired by the natural world, a little Irish magic and the belief that wonder is not something we grow out of, but something we learn to notice again. No perfect poses. No previous experience needed. Just curiosity, bare feet and a willingness to play. Come as you are. Leave a little lighter, a little freer, and perhaps a little closer to the part of yourself that already knows how to be magical alive.
activity_name_1755817289850541428: YOUR FESTIVAL JOURNEY: A CREATIVE JOURNEY THROUGH COLLAGE WITH RUTH & EL
activity_description_1755817289850541428: Join Ruth and El for a creative workshop of joyous reflection on your festival experience. Beginning and ending with a guided visualisation, this workshop will provide a safe and creative space to make a memento of your festival journey. Come away from your weekend with a map or small zine of your festival journey, to remind you of all the joy and shenanigans!
activity_name_1755817298650191220: RAW & RECITING : SPOKEN WORD HOUR WITH THE VAGABOND QUEEN, LULU SINNOTT & CATHAL HOLDEN
activity_description_1755817298650191220: Raw & Reciting is an intimate hour of spoken word in the Soft Landing space at Electric Picnic, featuring The Vagabond Queen, Lulu Sinott and Cathal Holden. Honest words, bold voices, lived experience and stories that linger long after they have been spoken. Step away from the festival rush, settle in and experience three distinctive performers sharing work that is fierce, tender, funny and unapologetically human. Come as you are, listen closely and let the words land.
activity_description_1755817307298846068: Dragging spoken word straight out of its skin, The Vagabond Queen is the sonic embodiment of a one-woman revolt, collapsing performance art into a seductive assault on the senses. An unpredictable ritual rooted in transformation, her immersive expression is a living force: brutal in its beauty, unflinching, intimate and shaped by the raw truth of lived experience that refuses to remain silent. An Irish and international performer described as magnetic, powerful and hypnotic, she is a devastatingly honest voice that speaks from grit and bone. This is spoken word from another world. Unbound. Alive in a fever dream.
activity_description_1755817316408874356: Cathal Holden, is a poet, hip hop artist and storyteller from the Dingle Peninsula. His words grow at the crossroads between the old world and the new, rooted in the oral tradition of the seanchaí and branching into modern realms of spoken word and hip hop. Cathal writes for firesides and forests, for love lost and found, i gcoir stáitse féile agus shráid na cathrach araon.
activity_description_1755817325686674804: Lulu Sinnott is an Irish poet and spoken-word performer whose writing explores place, memory, relationships and the beautifully complicated business of being human. Her poetry has appeared in A New Ulster, Cork Literary Review, Drawn to the Light, The Prose Poem and the PrimeCut/Axis Ballymun Anthology. A warm and engaging presence on stage, Lulu has performed in Ireland and internationally, including appearances in San Francisco, New York and Berlin. She hosts the monthly Poetry by the Barrow open mic in Graiguenamanagh and co-hosts Poetry by the Sea with ArtNetDLR. Returning to Serenity Gardens, Lulu brings poetry that is reflective, intimate and grounded in everyday life—inviting audiences to pause, listen and find something of themselves between the lines.
activity_description_1755915038121892292: Full Funktion is Irish techno duo Scott Curtis and Raymond O'Connor, crafting high-energy, hypnotic sets that blend driving rhythms with immersive sound design. Drawing inspiration from Detroit's underground grit, Berlin experimentation, and modern club-focused production, their sound is built on texture, tension, and momentum, combining pounding kick drums, intricate percussion, evolving synth layers, and cinematic atmospheres designed for late-night dancefloors. From DJ sets to original productions, Full Funktion creates a continuous journey of deep grooves, powerful breakdowns, and precision drops. Their music has been released on some of techno's most respected labels, including Kevin Saunderson's KMS Records, Sasha Carassi's Phobiq, Umek's 1605, 2000 and One and Sandy Huner's Bitten Records, as well as MKT, Orange Records, and Respekt, earning support from Eats Everything on BBC Radio 1. With a growing catalogue and an uncompromising passion for techno, Full Funktion continues to push forward with powerful, immersive performances.
activity_description_1755915038507768260: Cian has been with Transmission from the very beginning, working behind the scenes as our sound technician and delivering the beautiful sound and thumping bass that define the experience. A seasoned DJ since the age of 16, Cian’s passion for old-school classics shines through in his electrifying sets. Having performed at festivals such as Casapalooza and supported top names including John Gibbons and DJ Krisp, Cian’s mixes promise an unforgettable journey through timeless beats.
activity_description_1755915050729970116: Granted has his roots based in the techno music scene since the mid-1990s. This deep-rooted passion for the genre has profoundly influenced his unique sound and style. Expect everything from deep groovy tech house tracks to funky techno through to melodic and hard techno beats, his sets will have you dancing as he takes you on a journey from start to finish. Having been at the Transmission Stage at Electric Picnic since 2022, he showcases his deep appreciation for the genre's pioneers with each set. Granted continues to captivate audiences and contribute to the ever-evolving world of techno music whilst paying tribute to the artists and classics that gave him his passion from the start.
activity_description_1755915067054201284: DJ Victor Beesley has been organising gigs since 2000. "Seeing the DJ's play the crowd gave me the passion to study techniques and find my own groove". Taking inspiration from various genres he's been playing pubs, clubs and raves for the last 26 years. He brings his own flavour to this versatile mix of Artists.
activity_description_1755915067440077252: A true Transmission original, Furlong has been a cornerstone of the Transmission Stage since its very first edition in 2016. As the stage celebrates its 10th year, he returns once again to deliver the high-energy sets that have become a Transmission tradition. Known for his fearless and eclectic approach, Furlong blends techno, electro, acid, drum & bass, and more, taking crowds on an unpredictable journey across the electronic music spectrum. Expect deep grooves, driving rhythms, old-school influences, and fresh sounds, all woven together with his signature style. His infectious energy and commanding stage presence create an atmosphere that fills the dancefloor, while his ability to build the vibe keeps crowds moving from start to finish. Celebrating a decade of Transmission, don’t miss one of the festival’s longest-standing DJs as he once again brings the energy, passion, and soundtrack to another unforgettable year.
activity_description_1755915082875115972: Dj and multi media artist, MadGab has played her local circuit organised gigs and art events since Lamberts legendary heyday raves where she was a body artist and club gear designer. She was joint collaborator with Ali Ali when they created the first Transmission together at EP 2016. MadGab brings a unique perspective, playing multiple genres, her sets are an ecclectic mix of beats basslines and bangers. As one of the origional Soundclowns, her priority is to read the crowd and keep it lit.
activity_description_1755915092807227844: Based in Arklow, Co. Wicklow, Snell has been the driving force in the Wicklow underground dance scene for over a decade. With standout performances on the Mixmag Stage at All together Now Festival as well as a main room set at Index, Snell has built a reputation for delivering high-energy, no nonsense House and Techno sets that keep dancefloors moving from start to finish. A resident DJ at the Royal Arklow, Snell can also be found playing clubs and venues across Dublin throughout the year, bringing a deep passion for underground electronic music and a relentless focus on creating memorable moments on the dancefloor.
activity_description_1755915093209881028: For more than three decades, dancenastydj has been dedicated to underground electronic music, building a reputation for delivering energetic, carefully crafted DJ sets that blend house and trance with authentic underground sounds. With 30 years of DJ experience, dancenastydj has performed at intimate club nights, underground events, and community-driven electronic music gatherings, always focusing on the musical journey rather than trends. A resident DJ at Transmission Space for the past 10 years, dancenastydj has become known for creating immersive dancefloor experiences, moving between deep grooves, driving house rhythms, uplifting trance, and late-night underground selections. Every performance is built around connection, atmosphere, and keeping the dancefloor moving from the first track to the last.
activity_description_1755915101019675076: For over a decade, Mark Fitz has been blending driving techno, underground house and his own productions into high-energy sets that keep crowds moving. A regular on Electric Picnic's Transmission Stage since 2016, he's become known for championing Irish talent and bringing serious energy wherever he plays
activity_description_1755915111002118596: A lifelong audiophile vinyl record collector with decades behind the decks, DJ Vibez delivers a no-nonsense journey through underground electronic music. Fusing rolling Tech House, driving Techno, and timeless old-school rave classics. Part of the Transmission Stage family at Ireland’s Electric Picnic since 2019, Vibez has helped shape one of the festival’s underground spaces. As the Transmission crew marks its tenth year at Electric Picnic, he continues to represent the stage with passion, experience, and a deep love for electronic music.
activity_description_1755915117687839172: DJ MXRK is a house based DJ from Gorey, Co. Wexford, delivering groovy sets from start to finish. Expect a selection of house music built around groove, rhythm and keeping the energy flowing throughout.
activity_description_1755915118073715140: Raised in Ireland's thriving late-'90s techno scene, Baw found his inspiration at the legendary Club303, where a lifelong passion for electronic music was born. Influenced by progressive house, French house and techno, he has crafted a sound that flows from deep melodic grooves to pounding peak-time techno. A long-standing figure in the Gorey dance music scene, Baw has remained dedicated through every era of club culture, with appearances at Club303, Homelands, Mystic Festival, Audio Garden and Electric Picnic's Transmission Stage. Every set is a journey, built on one groove and designed to keep the dancefloor moving from start to finish.
activity_description_1755915129155066308: DrowZeeDan is aN Irish based sound terrorist with 25 years of bass warfare behind him. His sets are pure pressure: dubstep, bassline, 4x4, and UK garage delivered loud, dark, and uncompromising. From smashing big rooms back in the day like Twisted Pepper to Soundclowns and now Transmission Space to illegal beach parties and raves, he lives for the underground where the subs do the talking. Known for face-melting drops and relentless energy, DrowZeeDan doesn’t warm up rooms - he levels them. His latest release "Dan in Denia" is out now.
activity_description_1755915136713202116: Irish born techno DJ/producer. His driving industrial techno with euphoric atmospheres, he finds the perfect balance of timeless techno to lift the dancefloor higher and higher. Venues played: The Vaults, Twisted Pepper, local Clubs and Festivals.
activity_description_1755915145009535428: The man behind Transmission finally steps into the spotlight. As the creator of Electric Picnic's iconic UFO-inspired late-night experience, Ali Kemal Ali has spent the last decade shaping the stage, inspiring its artists and creating the world that thousands lose themselves in each year. For Transmission's 10th anniversary, he steps out from behind the scenes for a rare set of his own original productions. The man who started it all finally takes the decks.
activity_description_1755961851487172312: MAV666 is a Dublin based DJ and producer operating at the intersection of techno, trance and Latin tek, delivering high intensity and energetic sets. With a sound that leans into pressure and movement, Mav’s approach is both forceful and playful, built around tension that still feels undeniably fun. Mav describes her sound as “aliens chasing you with menacing beats, but still sexy, bouncy and trance driven.” That balance runs through her sets, blending hard, driving rhythms with euphoric energy and fluid transitions between styles to create something unpredictable but cohesive. Mav’s productions, including tracks like Static Chaos, Rock Dat Run Dat and Gone Girl, have landed on labels such as Coalition, ADERB, HATE , Shivers and Mahlwerk, gaining support from names like Clara Cuvé, Cera Khin, Samantha Togni and OTTA. A Boiler Room appearance in 2023 further marked Mav’s presence, alongside continued support across the underground circuit. Mav has brought this sound to cities across Ireland and Europe, from Dublin, Belfast and Galway to Berlin, Ibiza, Manchester, Glasgow, Nantes and beyond, translating it into high impact, floor focused sets.
activity_description_1755961871821158104: Shauna Dee is an emerging force in Ireland’s electronic music scene, known for her high-energy, multi-genre DJ sets that seamlessly blend House, Disco, and Techno into a driving, crowd-focused sound. With over six years of experience behind the decks, she has built a reputation for versatile, fast-paced performances that adapt to any stage while maintaining a distinct identity. In January, Shauna secured a standout milestone in her career when she was selected to support Ewan McVicar on his sold-out arena tour. She has performed at major festivals including Electric Picnic, Forbidden Fruit, All Together Now, and Longitude, alongside gigs across Ireland and international sets in Ibiza. She is also set to perform at Éalú le Grá in Galway and Forbidden Fruit this May, with many yet to be announced festival bookings, continuing a trajectory of high-profile bookings and growing recognition within the Irish electronic music scene. Shauna Dee continues to gain attention for her technical ability, crowd control, and energetic delivery behind the decks.
activity_description_1755961886232786648: DIEBYVEG is a distinctive selector out of the Irish electronic scene. Finding their feet within underground soundscapes including UKG and tech house, they have become known for their multi-genre approach which electrified dance floors across Ireland. DIEBYVEG performs high energy, unique and exciting sets with a distinct queer influence throughout. After being selected to close out the ‘Someplace Else’ stage at Forbidden Fruit 2025 and setting the pace for world renowned acts such as Interplanetary Criminal and Prozak, it is certain that DIEBYVEG is one to watch for the future. Charlotte, a Cork born and based DJ, has made a name for herself over the past 3 years with shows at Cyprus Avenue, Tengu, and the Telegraph Building, as well as recent appearances at Electric Picnic, Beyond the Pale, and Fuinneamh. Her sets traverse the spectrum of dance music, from bass and breakbeat to progressive house. With a love for groovy basslines and dynamic textures, she creates a sound that is playful, bouncy, and brimming with momentum - the perfect ingredients to keep you bopping into the early hours.
activity_description_1755961887205865176:
A high-energy techno sound driven by nostalgia, intensity and forward momentum. Lorcan Kelly reimagines familiar hooks through a heavy, modern lens, pairing rave-ready power with sharp, contemporary production. At just 22, he is already bridging generations - collaborating with techno pioneer Mark Broom while aligning with new-wave artists including STITCH and Kule. His productions have earned support from Kettama, Fred again.., Patrick Mason, Tafkamp, Grace Dahl, Truncate, Prospa, Blasha & Allatt, Bailey Ibbs, Danny Wabbit, and Skin On Skin.
His recent EP on Dublin-based label Hidden Love marks a new chapter - expanding his sound beyond peak-time pressure into deeper, more emotional territory while retaining the drive that defines his productions.
A sound built for the floor.
activity_description_1755961897322526424: LAWRENCE is a fast-rising DJ and producer from Ratoath, Co.Meath. Over the past few years, LAWRENCE has been carving his own lane in the scene, playing shows with promoters like District X, Forbidden Fruit, Index, Slither, The Lounge, Shed Residents and Lips2Ears - alongside sharing the stage with major global acts such as X-Club, Clouds, Club Angel, LB aka LABAT, Sunnysoposted, Luke Dean and Max Dean to name a few. With a love for both underground and more commercial leaning sounds, LAWRENCE's sets and discography drift between Techno, Trance and Garage, with his productions maintaining this fluidity - ranging from deep ambient cuts to club ready rollers. 2025 saw a major breakout year for LAWRENCE with shows across the board garnering huge support slots and playing to his biggest crowds yet, alongside earning over 300,000 plays and ascertaining support from artists like LB aka Labat, Future666 and Thelma - the second half of 2026 is forecasted to up the intensity once again, as LAWRENCE steps comfortably into a new level of performance and artistry. Kule has been steadily carving out his own sound within the Irish scene. Known for his euphoric synths and nostalgia laced piano tracks, he has gained support from the likes of Skin On Skin, Effy, KETTAMA and Tiësto. Blending diverse genres with his own original productions, Kule bridges the gap between house and techno in his sets. Over the last number of months he has played at iconic Irish venues such as Wigwam, Dolan’s, Monroes and Index.
activity_description_1755961898253661912: FAXE ON FAXE is a Dublin-based DJ, producer, and member of Dublin collective The Shed Residents, renowned for his dynamic sound. He typically blends hardgroove, hard house, and UK funky. His productions span multiple genres with a focus on house, hardgroove, and eurodance, allowing his groovy, funky, and percussive style to captivate audiences and energise dance floors. Having supported artists like MCR-T, Kink, DJ Aya, and more in Dublin’s top clubs, FAXE ON FAXE has built a strong reputation in the city’s nightlife. His music has been featured in major Irish publications such as District Magazine, Nialler9, and Four Four Magazine. FAXE ON FAXE has also made various festival appearances, featuring for The Shed Residents at Beyond The Pale and Fuinneamh.
activity_description_1755961906927482584: Over the past five years, OISINOK has carved out a distinctive place within Ireland’s thriving techno landscape. Known for dark, driving, and uncompromisingly dancefloor-focused selections, his sound balances raw intensity with moments of emotional depth—building immersive sets that feel both powerful and deeply resonant. He has played at Festivals such as Fuinneamh , Ifyouknow, Emerge, Outset, Electric Picnic and iconic venues including Index, XOYO ,The Telegraph Building, Dolans Warehouse and Silo as well as shows across Ireland aswell as Ibiza, London, Liverpool, Amsterdam & Glasgow.
activity_description_1755961927253079768:
Collie stands out as one of Dublin’s most consistent and dedicated selectors, earning a reputation for his deep musical knowledge, refined taste, and tireless work ethic. 
A familiar name across Ireland’s club circuit, Collie has graced the decks of every major venue and festival both at home and abroad, sharing lineups with heavyweights such as Sven Väth, DJ Seinfeld, Kerri Chandler, Sweely, and Chaos in the CBD. 
His international appearances include iconic stages like Fabric London further cementing his status as a trusted name in underground music circles.  
Raised in a musically rich environment, Collie began DJing at just 15 under the guidance of his father. Over the years, he’s built an extensive vinyl collection that spans genres and eras, allowing him to craft dynamic, unpredictable sets that move effortlessly between house, techno, and beyond.  
As a producer, Collie continues to push forward with a string of standout releases on respected imprints such as Out Straight Records and Traxx Underground. His latest 12” has already garnered strong support, with more vinyl releases lined up for 2026 - including an upcoming record on 393 Records and a fresh remix of a true Irish classic…  You can’t go far in Ireland’s club culture without hearing Collie’s name. His passion, authenticity, and versatility have made him one of the country’s most trusted selectors; his all-night-long sets showcase the full spectrum of his sound, from warm-up grooves to peak-time energy and after-hours depth.
activity_description_1755961933066385112: taurean is an Ireland-born, Berlin-based DJ, and promoter, who has developed her style with an affinity for hypnotic, driving & dubby techno. Heavily influenced by the early sounds of Detroit techno, as well as the 2000s uk dub/jungle movement, she is currently carving out her space in berlin's techno scene with appearances in Renate, Aeden & Tresor. As founder of the community platform and event series DOLLHAUS, she advocates for FLINTA and BIPOC artists, and seeks to create intentional spaces for us to party, as well as a refuge on our dancefloors.
activity_description_1755961939248789208:
Bronwyn is an emerging DJ from Dublin’s underground scene. Known for her hypnotic precision and deep, driving groove, she crafts sets that feel purpose-built for shadowy, immersive spaces.
A staple across Ireland’s most forward-thinking clubs and festivals, Bronwyn has supported international heavyweights including Kerrie, Ignez, 9x9, Zisko and more. Her reputation accelerated after a 12-hour marathon party alongside Ignez and Vilchezz — a testament to her ability to guide a crowd through long-form, full-body experiences.
Her sound is intentional and patient, rooted in minimal pressure and pulsing rhythms that blur the line between physical and cerebral. Bronwyn’s selections weave tension and release with surgical focus, creating a hypnotic atmosphere that locks dancers in and keeps them craving more. Expect layered textures, deep grooves, and a relentless undercurrent designed for the late-night forest energy.
With recent milestones including her debut at ADE, Bronwyn continues to carve her path. She brings a set built for movement, depth, and total immersion — a journey into the darker, more intense corners of the dancefloor.
activity_name_1756516111731864568: Sacred Sites of Ireland | Sean Scéalta
activity_description_1756516111731864568:
Sean Scéalta | Tales of the Sovereignty Goddesses of Ireland
Storytelling and song by Archaeologist and Bean Draoí Treasa Ní Mhurchú of Sacred Sites of Ireland, Bean Feasa Deirdre Wadding, Founder of Coire SOIS School of Irish Spirituality and Creative Director Ani Borg, Founder of Babylon's Inferno Artistic Collective.
activity_description_1756516119575213048: M⁠isleór Festival of Nomadic Cultures is Europe’s only festival dedicated to celebrating the arts, culture and lived experiences of nomadic communities. Founded by Galway Traveller Movement in 2019, Misleór brings together Traveller, Roma, Sámi and other nomadic artists, performers and cultural leaders from across the world to share music, storytelling, theatre, film, poetry and visual art while celebrating the richness and diversity of nomadic cultures. This year marks Misleór’s second visit to Electric Picnic, where the Hazelwood Stage will once again become a vibrant meeting place for Traveller and nomadic voices. Audiences can experience an exciting programme of music, spoken word and performance from Irish Traveller artists alongside performers from other nomadic communities, offering a unique glimpse into the creativity, resilience and living traditions that define Misleór. We’re delighted to bring a taste of Europe’s most distinctive celebration of nomadic cultures to Electric Picnic.
activity_description_1756516127544390648: COSCÁN, formed in 1998, are a Traditional Folk band from Slane, Co. Meath have been busy performing at venues all over Ireland and Europe. With 3 highly acclaimed albums, COSCÁN is Harry Long (whistles, guitar and vocals), David Nevin (bodhrán, keyboards, guitar and vocals), Gerry Doggett (fiddle, accordian and whistles) and Kieran Weldon (guitar and vocals). COSCÁN are currentlybusy composing, arranging and recording new music. Collaboration between the four band members knows no limits. As with their previous album, COSCÁN compose music influenced by the ancient monuments and folklore of the Boyne Valley, particularly the village of Slane, Newgrange, Tara and surrounds.
activity_description_1756516144120280056: Is banna gatch-cheoil as Chathair Luimnigh iad Major Feen. Bunaithe i dtosach na Bliana 2024, cuireann an grúpa poirt traidisiúnta agus fuinneamh punk le chéile chun a bhfuaim féin a chruthú. Go dtí anois, tá E.P agus an singil darbh aimn ‘Last City’ curtha amach acu agus neart le teacht. Hailing from Limerick, Major Feen is an emerging Irish band blending raw punk sensibilities with deep-rooted traditional Irish folk. Taking their name from a fusion of military rank and the Munster vernacular word for man (“feen”), the group delivers an authentic, high-energy sound steeped in storytelling, heritage, and rebellion. Their music relies on physical, acoustic exertion and a do-it-yourself spirit. Major Feen reimagines old Irish traditions through contemporary narratives, capturing both complex craftsmanship and the chaotic charm of live performance. A prominent force within the burgeoning local music scene, the band has earned acclaim through high-octane showcases across Limerick.
activity_description_1756516152425001976: Experience the raw energy, passion, and melodic genius of The Liam O'Connor Show, a spellbinding celebration of deep-rooted traditional Irish music, song, and dance.Led by internationally renowned multi-instrumentalist Liam O’Connor, the performance delivers an extraordinary blend of vibrant Irish heritage and contemporary mastery. Celebrated as the 2012 Instrumentalist of the Year and 2026 Family Band of the Year at the Irish Entertainment Awards, O’Connor brings a world-class production to life alongside his immensely talented family. Featuring Saoirse (vocals, concertina, keyboards), Oisín (guitars, keyboards, percussion), and Cillian (drums), this dynamic ensemble creates an unforgettable stage presence.  A staple of major international events and returning for his seventh year at Electric Picnic, Liam O’Connor delivers a powerful show that stands proudly among the best live music acts in the world.
activity_description_1756516162424222712: Fierin j is a four-piece band from Clare that primarily plays indie rock. They like to write originals and enjoy the creative process, but they also cover songs by popular artists in the genre. They have played gigs across Clare with the Clare Youth Service and other live music venues in the county, and they look forward to venturing outside of the county. They are forever grateful for the opportunity. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.
activity_description_1756516176894571512: Paradise Conspiracy is a four-piece band from Tipperary. They have been together for a year and a half and have played a number of gigs throughout Ireland. Their catalog comprises originals and covers, and they are currently working on adding new original material to their setlist. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.
activity_description_1756516193554347000: Beomhar is a group of 8 musicians from Laois and Offaly. They were formed to compete in the prestigious Siansa Gael Linn competition, which showcases the top young trad musicians across Ireland. Last year they reached the final, and this year they were placed 2nd overall. All members of Beomhar play multiple instruments and all have provincial and All Ireland medals at Fleadh Cheoil. They are members of the Music Generation Trad Orchestra and the Senior Harp Ensemble, as well as Ceoltóirí Óga Laighean. Their mentor is Siobhan Buckley of Laois Music Generation. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.
activity_description_1756516206397305848: Makayla Chloe is a singer-songwriter from County Kildare. Her influences include Noah Kahan and Zach Bryan, and she has been writing songs since she was 14. Her first song was featured in a recent season of the Netflix show Ginny & Georgia. Electric Youth is a vibrant celebration of creativity and talent for young people aged 14-24 – this eagerly anticipated annual collaboration between Youth Work Ireland Laois and Electric Picnic which showcases the transformative power of music, arts and youthwork, highlighting its positive impact on the lives of its young participants. Electric Youth provides a unique platform for showcasing the remarkable skills and passions of these individuals, many of whom are self-taught artists, musicians, singers, or poets, many of whom are creating and performing to an enthusiastic and encouraging audience for the first time at Electric Youth.
activity_description_1756516219810690040: Oracle Villa are an original rock n roll band from Kilkenny, Ireland. Steeped in the musical heritage of their home town, the trio draws influence from roots, grunge, indie and punk . Their sound, described by Hotpress as ‘heavy on the strums, light on the ears’ is powerful yet melodic, inviting and yet unforgiving. They released their debut album to a sold-out crowd in Cleere’s, Kilkenny on the 20th June before embarking on a small Irish tour.
activity_description_1756516228786500600: Formed in October 2025 as a grassroots community gathering, The Caochaleles have swiftly evolved into one of County Laois’s most dynamic and uplifting musical ensembles. What began as a modest weekly meetup at Coach O’Leary’s pub in Ballacolla has rapidly scaled into a full-fledged acoustic phenomenon.  The Caochaleles bring an infectious, high-energy repertoire spanning timeless folk classics, pop anthems, and crowd-pleasing sing-alongs. Rooted in camaraderie, inclusivity, and traditional Irish craic, their performances bridge the gap between audience and stage.
activity_description_1756516237107999736: Lúila is a singer/songwriter from limerick, Ireland, whose sound fuses soulful vocals with rock energy and unmistakable Irish folk edge. The lead singer of Limerick blues-rock band Edged in Blue, she recently brought her powerhouse presence to this years Rory Gallagher festival, channeling the spirit of classic guitar-  driven music on stage. Rooted in Ireland’s traditions, Lúila has also delved into Sean-nós and Irish trad, weaving that ornamented, story-first style into her own originals and interpretations. Her influences span Delores O’Riardan, Sinead O’Connor to Stevie Nicks and Alanis Morissette- 70s/80s rock queens whose grit, poetry, and vulnerability inform lúila’s dynamnic phrasing and delivery. Songs of feeling and empowerment with rock and roll flair, shot through with old Irish folk attitude. For this festival appearance, Lúila is joined by limerick guitarist Mike Hennigar (edged in blue, Sweets, Trench Knife), whose expressive tone and melodic bite add vivid colour to her emotive storytelling.
activity_description_1756516246671012856:
An Galar Dub v shelovescalpol with Julie Goo on the mic. Bounce around to sounds from The Marsh as this Cork trio collaborates, ahead of the release of their EP.
An Galar Dub is a bass-heavy electronic producer whose tracks are played across dance floors and radio stations internationally. shelovescalpol (SLC) comprises of producer & DJ Milis and bilingual poet/singer Julie Goo. SLC are an award nominated bilingual hip hop/trip hop Cork duo making waves across Irish radio. Bígí linn.
activity_description_1756516254329811960: Creations from Irish musician Jeremy Morgan. Fusing Irish with Global Traditional and Contemporary Sounds, from Uilleann Pipes to Analogue Synths, Prepared Piano to Projection mapping.
activity_description_1756516264001876984: Tigh na Coille is an award-winning traditional Irish music, song, and dance ensemble from County Clare, Ireland. Named after their homeplace (meaning "house in the woods"), the group features talented teens and young adults directed by renowned musicians and educators Denis Liddy and Elvie Miller.
activity_description_1756516264387752952:
Tá gluaiseacht hip-hap na Gaeilge ag dul ó neart go neart le blianta beaga anuas, le ceoltóirí, filí, agus rapálaithe ag ceiliúradh na teanga i gclubanna agus i bhféilte ar fud na tíre.  Is ceolchoirmeacha agus oícheanta filíochta iad Hip-Hap Gaelach a chuireann litríocht agus teanga bheo na hip-haipe ar ardán os comhair slua.
There has been a surge of Irish language hip hop music in the past few years, with musicians, rappers, and poets celebrating the form in clubs and at festivals around the country. Hip Hap Gaelach is a celebration if Irish language hip hop culture and artists that brings the living literature and language to audiences. First featured by CEOLTA at IMRAM 2026, curated by Eoin P. Ó Murchú, this Hazelwood installation will be curated by rapper James Shannon.
activity_description_1756516272793138168:
Lena stíl shainiúil scríbhneoireachta agus dlúthnasc lena bhaile, tá aird tarraingthe ag Rua Rí (nó Seán Damery) air fhéin mar charachtar lárnach i gceol neámhspleách Chathair Chorcaí le cúpla bliain anuas. Agus a chéad albam, “Tell Your Mother I Saved Your Life” (Soft Boy Records), eisithe i mbliana, tugann sé faoi amhráin ón albaim agus seit dhátheangach dúinn sa Chollchoill.
With a knack for sensitive lyricism and a deep connection to his home, Rua Rí (aka Sean Damery) has gained significant attention in Cork City’s independent scene over the last few years. Fresh off the release of his debut album “Tell Your Mother I Saved Your Life” (Soft Boy Records) he joins us for songs from the album and a bilingual set sa Chollchoill
activity_description_1756516287448036344:
Is banna dinimiciúil damhsa as Contae na Gaillimhe iad CLADA. Bunaithe i mí an Mhárta 2024, tá siad tar éis ollthionchar a imirt ar a lucht féachana trí cheol traidisiúnta Éireannach a chumasc le buillí pop, func, agus damhsa. 
Hailing from Co. Galway on the Wild Atlantic Way, CLADA are at the forefront of Irish Dance Music — a sound rooted deep in the West of Ireland's living tradition and driven by the kind of infectious rhythmic energy that gets a room on its feet.
Born out of late-night sessions and a fierce love of the music, the band brings together some of the most exciting young players on the scene. Their performances are a masterclass in tension and release — tight, propulsive IDM at its best, shot through with the raw authenticity of Connacht tradition.
activity_description_1756516296792945656: Is banna óg folk-pop as Cill Chainnigh Burnchurch, banna teaghlaigh iad a bhfuil fuaim chomhaimseartha á thógáil acu ar a bhfréamhacha Éireannacha. Tá cáil orthu as a n-amhráin a mheascann foinn a ngreamódh san intinn, scéalaíocht láidir, agus rianta an folk comhaimseartha, an tsnagcheoil agus ceol traidisiúnta. Ó bhuscáil i gCill Chainnigh go hardáin náisiúnta, tá Burnchurch ag dul ó neart go neart le ceol atá úr, inaitheanta, agus dílis dóibh féin. Burnchurch is a young folk-pop band from Kilkenny, Ireland, made up of talented siblings who blend Irish roots with a modern sound. Known for their high-energy live shows and feel-good atmosphere.
activity_description_1756516306959938552: Is banna dátheangach traidisúnta Gaelach / Ceilteach / Tíre / Pop iad Leatsa, as Gaillimh. Léimeann siad isteach i réimse leathan de cheol - idir phoirt phreabacha na hÉireann, na bailéid spreagúla, agus amhráin mhóra a dhéanann cór den lucht féachana. Tá blianta de thaithí acu os comhair an tsaoil mhóir a thagann go Gaillimh agus chuig na háiteanna móra le rá a mbíonn Leatsa ag casadh iontu go rialta sa gcathair, agus nuair a bhítear ag gig dá gcuid, is cinnte go mbeidh fuinneamh ar leith ann. Tá siad ag súil go mór le ceol, teanga agus fuinneamh na nGael a bhreith leo aniar chuig an bPicnic Leictreach i mbliana.
activity_description_1756516324584403960:
Is amhránaithe agus seinnteoirí consairtín iad Méabh Mulligan agus Eva Carroll, as Baile Átha Cliath agus Oirthear an Chláir. Tá cúlra ceoil acu beirt - is í Eva iníon na n-amhránaithe Brian O’Rourke agus Paula Carroll, agus is teaghlach Mhéabh atá i bhfeighil ar an Cobblestone i Margadh na Feirme, áit a gcasann na cailíní go minic. Casann siad amhráin in éindí as Béarla agus as Gaeilge le tionlacain consairtín, anuas ar na tunes ar ndóigh! 
Méabh Mulligan and Eva Carroll are two singing concertina players hailing from East Clare and Dublin. They both come from musical families, Eva being the daughter of singers Brian O’Rourke and Paula Carroll, while Méabh’s family run the Cobblestone pub in Smithfield, Dublin, where the two girls play on a regular basis. Méabh took Eva out of her musical shell and they have been playing together ever since!
activity_description_1756516337687409656:
“Rac an Phortaigh” nó “Draoirac” a thugtar ar cheol Bog Bodies go minic, banna tromfolk a bhunaigh an t-amhránaí agus antraipeolaí Dan Maher. Réimse staidéir agus suim Dan i gcultúir ársa a spreag seánra ardfhuinneamh an bhanna a tharraingíonn amhráin ón éitear le linn a gcuairtíocht ar tuamaí meigiliteacha agus suíomhanna seanda eile.
Bog Bodies are a heavy folk outfit (often dubbed “Bog Rock” or “Druid Rock”) formed by Irish singer-songwriter and anthropologist Dan Maher. Their genre-bending, high-energy folk sound is inspired by Dan’s close study and appreciation of ancient culture, pulling songs from the ether during visits to megalithic tombs and other ancient sites.
activity_description_1756516347216868344:
Banna ceoil ó chontae na Mí, is dlúthchairde iad Aoife Moore agus Kevin Burke. D’athraigh siad ainm an bhanna le déanaí ó ‘We’re Not Together’ go ‘Birch’. Cloistear ina gceol nithe den cheol folk ó na 60dí, chomh maith le ceol rac ó na 70dí. Beidh banna iomlán leo i mbliana ag an bPicnic.

Birch (formerly known as We’re Not Together) are a band and best friends Aoife Moore and Keving Burke from Meath. Their music weaves elements of 60s folk with 70s rock. They played Electric Picnic for the first time in 2023 with the help of Phil Christie and Joshua Murtagh on keys, Chris Barry on Bass, Donal Bowens on drums and Aoife Kelly on the fiddle. They will play with a full band at this year’s festival.
activity_description_1756516358742815736: DJ Nemo or DJ No Name.  Spinning the ones and twos with an eclectic mix of music from the past, present and future during our turnarounds.
activity_description_1756516366686827512: Aoife Breathnach and Helen de Búrca make up Léaró, a folk-pop girl band from Fingal, North County Dublin. Having grown up together as best friends since their school days, Aoife and Helen bonded over a shared love of music and theatre. This interest inspires their romantic, lyrical style, emphasising performance and storytelling. With Aoife’s vocals and guitar paired with Helen’s accompaniment on harp and Q-chord, Léaró combines sounds to create a unique blend of dark, strong, smoky folk and light, delicate, dreamy pop. Join Léaró at the Hazelwood Stage on Thursday for a mix of nostalgic covers and original songs, with playful strumming, doleful melodies, and deeply earnest storytelling.
activity_description_1756516379336848376: MARYANN is a rising force on Ireland’s pop scene, blending glittering, feel-good energy with emotional depth and sharp lyrical wit. Hannah Montana’s sparkle meets the rich, emotive tones of Dido — powerful, expressive vocals that move effortlessly between vulnerability, fragility, humour and bold pop confidence.Her songwriting is rooted in sincerity, exploring the highs and lows of modern life, lust and love; with a refreshing honesty, while never losing a playful, self-aware edge. There is a distinct comedic thread woven through her work, giving audiences not just something to feel, but something to smile and laugh at too. Having already built momentum through live performances at renowned venues such as Cleere’s in Kilkenny, Carlow Arts Festival and Fred Zeppelin’s in Cork, MARYANN is quickly gaining a reputation for her dynamic and engaging stage presence. Vivacious, invigorating, and unapologetically glamorous, MARYANN offers a performance that is both emotionally resonant and irresistibly fun.
activity_description_1756516392918004728:
The ladies of Entr’acte Musical Theatre and Dramatic Society present to you our ‘miscast’ set. Performing songs typically sung by male performers in male roles, let our ladies take you on a journey and imagine iconic musical numbers with new textures, vocal ranges, and dramatic interpretations.
Entr’acte is a performing arts group that produces bold and innovative theatre for Ireland’s creatives. We are incredibly excited for our Electric Picnic debut - bringing the musical theatre experience to the festival audience.
activity_name_1756516405635134456: INNNER VISION, Visual Light Projection by Susan Walsh
activity_description_1756516405635134456: Visual Artist Susie Walsh uses darkspace projection to create immersive environments. Her practice investigates how light, colour, and translucent materials interact to create vibrant visual, physical, and psychological experiences. Using a combination of analogue and digital light projecting devices, her work interrogates themes of time passing and ecological concern, exploring the interplay between bodily and mental experience. Through spatial unfolding in the darkspace, her projections construct captivating illusions and synthetic worlds.
activity_description_1756516416330609656: Morrigna Productions present Spreacha na gCoillte - Sparks of the Woods, a bespoke piece for Hazelwood Stage at Electric Picnic. This intimate fire performance; merges circus, group choreography, and Irish music. It is an invitation for all to connect with and celebrate our living roots through the ancestral practice of gathering in community around fire.
activity_description_1756516432713561080: An Chollchoill | The Hazelwood, Thursday night host is Bláithín de Burca (known online as BlaComedy). Bláithín is an Irish stand-up comedian, writer, and presenter from Dublin. She is well known for her work on YouTube's The Try Channel, presenting the RTÉ documentary The Irish For Sex, and her live comedy shows exploring feminism, dating, and neurodivergence.
activity_description_1756526063925948784: Shrem is a Dublin-based DJ, vinyl selector and music blogger known for eclectic disco, house and boogie sets. A regular at Mother he brings crate-dug rarities and pure dancefloor joy to every set.
activity_description_1756526080719942000: Glamo is a member of the Mother Club family, a frequent guest known for high-energy sets that blend house, disco, techno, and queer anthems. A staple of Dublin’s queer nightlife, Glamo brings bold beats and euphoric vibes to every stage, creating unforgettable dancefloor moments rooted in celebration, freedom, and fierce self-expression.
activity_description_1756526097539101040: Rocky T. Delgado is a resident DJ at Mother and a cornerstone of Dublin’s queer club scene. Known for their genre-blurring sets of house, disco, techno, and rave classics, Rocky brings high energy, deep grooves, and pure queer joy to every set — always keeping the dancefloor locked and lifted.
activity_description_1756526120356114800: Kelly-Anne Byrne is one of Ireland’s most beloved DJs, known for her deep love of disco, house, and soul. With acclaimed radio shows and unforgettable club sets, she’s a master selector who brings heart, groove, and pure dancefloor joy wherever she plays, from sweaty clubs to massive festival stages.
activity_description_1756526137460486512: The Mother DJs: Ruth Kavanagh, and Ghostboy bring their signature queer sound to the forest  for euphoric late-night dancing. Expect genre-blending sets, big queer anthems, and deep club cuts under the trees. It’s all about freedom, joy, and dancefloor connection deep in the woods.

activity_description_1756599498991662804: The team from Paladar cocktail bar in Cork team up with Casasmigos to showcase agave-based Mexican spirits.

activity_description_1756599517454989012: We look forwards and back with Seaneen O'Sullivan from Stoneybatter's L Mulligans Grocer public house and Ann-Marie Duffin from Bia Duit and host Aoife Carrigy
